		    If Type("thisform.oCstImprimecomprobantes")<>T_OBJECT
		                   thisform.AddObject("oCstImprimecomprobantes","Tg_ImprimeComprobantes")
		    Endif     
		
		    **** 20-09-2012 Reimpresion fiscal
		    thisform.oCstImprimecomprobantes.ImprimirComprobante(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_comproba,nReferencia,nCopias,lConfImpresion,lSoloPendientesRomaneo, nOpcionImpresion, nCantCopiasRomaneo, @vVectorDescarga, , , , , ,lreimpresion)
		    **** 20-09-2012 Reimpresion fiscal
		Endif     
		
		
		
		
		
		*!*	lParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nReferencia,nCopias,lConfImpresion,lSoloPendientesRomaneo, nOpcionImpresion, nCantCopiasRomaneo, vVectorDescarga
		
		
		*!*	If oApp.PedirPermiso('COM',cId_Comproba,'I',cId_Sistema)
		*!*		
		*!*		If Type("thisform.oCstImprimecomprobantes")<>T_OBJECT
		*!*			thisform.AddObject("oCstImprimecomprobantes","Tg_ImprimeComprobantes")
		*!*		Endif	
		*!*		thisform.oCstImprimecomprobantes.ImprimirComprobante(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_comproba,nReferencia,nCopias,lConfImpresion,lSoloPendientesRomaneo, nOpcionImpresion, nCantCopiasRomaneo, @vVectorDescarga)
		*!*		
		*!*	Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE incrementarinstancia
		if type("oApp")=T_OBJECT and thisform.WindowType<>1
			thisform.instancias=oApp.addInstance(thisform)
			thisform.FormOldName=thisform.Name
			if thisform.Instancias>1
				thisform.Name=alltrim(thisform.name)+alltrim(str(thisform.Instancias))
				thisform.SetearCaption(thisform.caption)
			endif	
		endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		this.disparoGetFocus = .F.
		
		** Mati Sas 05/05/2017
		IF oApp.oTblParametros.Leer("ResizerDesActivado")
			thisform.borderStyle = 2
		ELSE
		    Thisform.AddObject("mwresize1","mwresize")
		    thisform.mwresize1.Visible = .f.
		    thisform.borderStyle = 3
		ENDIF
		** Mati Sas 05/05/2017
		
		** LUCHO M. 18-06-10
		If Upper(Right(Sys(16,0),3))="EXE"
			On Error Do BandejaDeErrores
		Endif
		** LUCHO M. 18-06-10
		
		*-- Restaurar la posición de la ventana desde el archivo INI
		if type("thisform.TipoFormulario")=T_CHARACTER
			thisform.tipoFormulario=TG_TIPOFORMCOMUN
		endif	
		thisform.tg_timerBase.Enabled=.f.
		thisform.tg_timerBase.Interval=10
		*!*	thisform.addObject("oEnvironment","tg_environment")
		*!*	thisform.oEnvironment.Set()
		
		** LUCHO M. 23-12-11
		** Modifico el caption para avisar que hay un instructivo disponible
		** LUCAS COMENTE PORQUE TIRA ACCESO DENGADO AL ARCHIVO
		Local otbldocumentacion
		otbldocumentacion = createobject("Tg_tabla", "Documentacion", "clave")
		
		If otbldocumentacion.buscar(padr(upper(allt(thisform.class)),50,space(1)),.f.,"clave")
			ThisForm.Caption = Alltrim(ThisForm.Caption) + Space(10) + ">> Presione Ctrl+I para visualizar el instructivo"
		Endif
		Release otbldocumentacion
		** LUCHO M. 23-12-11
		
		If thisform.TopLeftRegistrado
			thisform.RestoreWindowPos()	
		Endif	
		
		
		thisform.AgregarBarVentana
		thisform.IncrementarInstancia
		thisform.AgregarMenuYTool
			
		
		thisform.ModoEdicion=.f.
		
		*@409@*
		oApp.ControlarHabilitacionSistema()
		*@409@*
		
		**oApp.ChequearVersion
		
		&& EZEQUIEL 07/09/2015
		if Upper(Right(Sys(16,0),3))="EXE"
			If alltrim(upper(thisform.class)) = "TG_ALTACOMPROBANTE"
				oApp.chequearConsistenciaDB(.T.)
			Else
				oApp.chequearConsistenciaDB(.F.)
			Endif
		endif
		&& EZEQUIEL 07/09/2015
		
		** LUCHO M. 09-06-10
		** Pregunto si audita formularios grabo una apertura de formulario
		if oApp.oTblParametros.ExisteCampo("AuditaFormularios")
			if oApp.oTblParametros.Leer("AuditaFormularios") and type("oApp.oAUDITORIA") = "O"
		***		thisform.CodigoAuditoria = oApp.oAUDITORIA.AuditarAperturaFormulario(oApp.CodUsuario(), oApp.Maquina, this.Caption, this.Name)
				** Matias S. 07/12/16 **
				IF TYPE("thisform.nombrelistado") = "C"
					thisform.CodigoAuditoria = oApp.oAUDITORIA.AuditarAperturaFormulario(oApp.CodUsuario(), oApp.Maquina, this.Caption, this.nombreListado, thisform.TipoFormulario==TG_TIPOFORMABMCABECERA, thisform.TipoFormulario==TG_TIPOFORMLISTADO)
				ELSE
					thisform.CodigoAuditoria = oApp.oAUDITORIA.AuditarAperturaFormulario(oApp.CodUsuario(), oApp.Maquina, this.Caption, this.Name, thisform.TipoFormulario==TG_TIPOFORMABMCABECERA, thisform.TipoFormulario==TG_TIPOFORMLISTADO)
				ENDIF 
				
				IF oApp.Version() = "9"
					thisform.actualizarRecientes()
				Endif
				** Matias S. 07/12/16 **
			endif
		ENDIF
		
		thisform.nombrelistado = .F.
		** LUCHO M. 09-06-10
		
		
		** MATI SAS 30/05/2013
		cNombreInstructivoAAbrir = thisform.name
		ON KEY LABEL CTRL+I do mostrarInstructivos with cNombreInstructivoAAbrir 
		** MATI SAS 30/05/2013
		
		** MATI SAS 24/02/17
		ON KEY LABEL CTRL+N IIF(oApp.Cargar("NuevoHabilitado"),oApp.Ejecutar("Nuevo"),.T.)
		ON KEY LABEL CTRL+F4 IIF(oApp.Cargar("CerrarHabilitado"),oApp.Ejecutar("Cerrar"),.T.)
		ON KEY LABEL CTRL+G IIF(oApp.Cargar("GuardarHabilitado"),oApp.Ejecutar("Guardar"),.T.)
		ON KEY LABEL CTRL+T IIF(oApp.Cargar("RevertirHabilitado"),oApp.Ejecutar("Revertir"),.T.)
		ON KEY LABEL CTRL+DEL IIF(oApp.Cargar("EliminarHabilitado"),oApp.Ejecutar("Eliminar"),.T.)
		ON KEY LABEL CTRL+E IIF(oApp.Cargar("EditarHabilitado"),oApp.Ejecutar("Editar"),.T.)
		ON KEY LABEL CTRL+HOME IIF(oApp.Cargar("PrimeroHabilitado"),oApp.Ejecutar("IrPrimero"),.T.)
		ON KEY LABEL CTRL+PGUP IIF(oApp.Cargar("AnteriorHabilitado"),oApp.Ejecutar("IrAnterior"),.T.)
		ON KEY LABEL CTRL+PGDN IIF(oApp.Cargar("SiguienteHabilitado"),oApp.Ejecutar("IrSiguiente"),.T.)
		ON KEY LABEL CTRL+END IIF(oApp.Cargar("UltimoHabilitado"),oApp.Ejecutar("IrUltimo"),.T.)
		** MATI SAS 24/02/17
		
		
		
		
		
		** Matías S. 08/06/16 **
		IF oApp.oTblParametros.leer("separadorMiles")
			thisform.cargarInputmasks()
		ENDIF
		** Matías S. 08/06/16 **
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE int_edicion
		Local cCondicion,cComandoFalso,cComandoVerdadero,mmpp, vAuxiliar
		
		Dimension vAuxiliar[1]
		
		For mmpp=1 to 9
			if alltrim(thisform.vIntEdicion[mmpp])<>""
				cCondicion=fstrGenerico(alltrim(thisform.vIntEdicion[mmpp]),1,"**")
				cComandoVerdadero=fstrGenerico(alltrim(thisform.vIntEdicion[mmpp]),2,"**")
				cComandoFalso=fstrGenerico(alltrim(thisform.vIntEdicion[mmpp]),3,"**")
				If &cCondicion
					&cComandoVerdadero
				Else
					if alltrim(cComandoFalso)<>""
						&cComandoFalso
					Endif	
				Endif
			Endif
		EndFor
		
		=acopy (thisform.vIntEdicion, vAuxiliar)
		thisform.VerificarHabilitacionesControles(@vAuxiliar)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE iranterior
		if type("thisform.oMaestro")=T_OBJECT
			if not thisform.oMaestro.EsBof()
				thisform.oMaestro.IrAnterior
			endif
		
			thisform.refrescarAbmCabecera
		endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE irprimero
		if type("thisform.oMaestro")=T_OBJECT
			thisform.oMaestro.IrPrimero
		
			thisform.refrescarAbmCabecera
		endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE irsiguiente
		if type("thisform.oMaestro")=T_OBJECT
			if not thisform.oMaestro.Eseof()
				thisform.oMaestro.IrSiguiente
			endif
		
			thisform.refrescarAbmCabecera
		endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE irultimo
		if type("thisform.oMaestro")=T_OBJECT
			thisform.oMaestro.IrUltimo
		
			thisform.refrescarAbmCabecera
		endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE KeyPress
		LPARAMETERS nKeyCode, nShiftAltCtrl
		*!*	local loShell, lcFile, otbldocumentacion,otblTerminal,cRespuesta
		
		*!*	otbldocumentacion = createobject("tg_tabla", "documentacion", "clave")
		*!*	otblTerminal	  =	createobject("tg_tabla", "Terminal"		, "Clave")
		
		*!*	oTblTerminal.Buscar(oApp.Maquina)
		
		*!*	cRespuesta = alltrim(oTblTerminal.Leer("dirCentral") )
		
		*!*	if nKeyCode=9 and otbldocumentacion.buscar(padr(upper(allt(thisform.class)),20,space(1)),.f.,"clave")
		*!*		lcFile  = '"' + Alltrim(cRespuesta) + Alltrim(otbldocumentacion.leer("path")) + '"'
		*!*		loShell = createobject("Shell.Application")
		*!*		loShell.ShellExecute(lcFile)
		*!*		release loShell
		*!*	endif
		
		*!*	release otbldocumentacion
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE liberarobjetos
		for mmpp=1 to alen(thisform.vobjetos)
			mvaraux=thisform.vobjetos[mmpp]
			if type("mvaraux")="O" and type("mVarAux")<>T_LOGICAL 
			    &mVarAux=3 &&..Destroy
			endif	
		endfor
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Load
		** VERSION NUEVA
		*** Lucas aca habria que abrir en una variable local la tabla mainmenu
		*** buscar por el indice nuevo esta clase (indexar por upper())
		*** y hacer el buscar del upper de la clase de este formulario
		*** si el id_tipoproceso=CON poner la propiedad esconsultagrid en verdadero
		*** sino dejarlo en falso
		*** hay que hacerlo en esta metodo ya que en el init haria primero el init de la grilla y luego
		*** el init del formulario
		*** agregar nuevo campo en mainmenu 
		** VERSION NUEVA
		LOCAL cNombreProceso, oMainmenu
		
		thisform.addObject("oEnvironment","tg_environment")
		thisform.oEnvironment.Set()
		
		cNombreProceso = this.Class
		
		oMainMenu = CreateObject ("tg_tabla", "Mainmenu","TipoProc")
		
		If oMainMenu.Buscar("CON"+UPPER(cNombreProceso),.f.,"TipoProc")
		 IF oMainMenu.Leer("consultagrilla")
		  	this.esconsultagrid = .t.
		 Endif 	
		Endif
		
		If oMainMenu.Buscar("CON"+UPPER(cNombreProceso),.f.,"TipoProc")
		 IF oMainMenu.Leer("saltearrenglon")
		  	this.interlineado = .t.
		 Endif 	
		Endif
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
		** VERSION NUEVA
		
		
		*!*	thisform.addObject("oEnvironment","tg_environment")
		*!*	thisform.oEnvironment.Set()
		*!*	thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE obtenerinputmaskmonetaria
		** Mati Sas 19/05/16 **
		*!*	lParameters cId_comproba
		*!*	Local cModulo, nCantidadEnteros, nCantidadDecimales, cInputMask, i, cDelimitadorMiles, nEnterosIniciales, cDelimitadorDecimales
		
		*!*	cDelimitadorMiles = ","
		*!*	cDelimitadorDecimales = "."
		
		*!*	cModulo = ""
		*!*	nCantidadEnteros = 0
		*!*	nCantidadDecimales = 0
		
		*!*	if thisform.oTblMainMenuParaMask.buscar(thisform.name, .F., "ID_PROCESO")
		*!*		cModulo = thisform.oTblMainMenuParaMask.leer("id_modulo")
		*!*	endif 
		
		*!*	if TYPE("cId_comproba") = "C" AND !empty(cId_comproba)
		*!*		DO CASE
		*!*			CASE cModulo = "V"
		*!*				if thisform.oTblVnt_docu.buscar(cId_comproba, .F., "CLAVE")
		*!*					nCantidadEnteros = thisform.oTblVnt_docu.leer("enteros_precio")
		*!*					nCantidadDecimales = thisform.oTblVnt_docu.leer("decimales_precio")
		*!*				endif 
		
		*!*			Case cModulo = "C"
		
		*!*		ENDCASE
		*!*	endif
		
		*!*	IF nCantidadEnteros = 0 AND nCantidadDecimales = 0
		*!*		nCantidadEnteros = oApp.oTblParametros.leer("enteros_precio")
		*!*		nCantidadDecimales = oApp.oTblParametros.leer("decimales_precio")
		*!*	ENDIF
		
		*!*	cInputMask = ""
		
		*!*	nEnterosIniciales = 0
		*!*	do while nCantidadEnteros % 3 <> 0
		*!*		nCantidadEnteros = nCantidadEnteros - 1
		*!*		nEnterosIniciales = nEnterosIniciales + 1
		*!*		cInputMask = cInputMask + "9"
		*!*	enddo
		
		*!*	if nEnterosIniciales > 0
		*!*		cInputMask = cInputMask + cDelimitadorMiles
		*!*	endif 
		
		*!*	For i = 1 TO nCantidadEnteros / 3
		*!*		cInputMask = cInputMask + REPLICATE('9', 3) + cDelimitadorMiles
		*!*	endfor 
		
		*!*	cInputMask = SUBSTR(cInputMask,1,LEN(cInputMask)-1)
		
		*!*	cInputMask = cInputMask + cDelimitadorDecimales + REPLICATE('9', nCantidadDecimales)
		
		*!*	return cInputMask
		** Mati Sas 19/05/16 **
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE pruebagrabar
		IF EVAL(thisform.ActiveControl.ControlSource) <> thisform.ActiveControl.Value
			replace categorias.nombre with thisform.page0.mnombre.value
		Endif	
		
		lGrabacionExitosa=tableupdate(2,.t.,thisform.oMaestro.Alias)
		if !lgrabacionExitosa
		Endif
		
		return .t.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		if !lAnularError
			if !thisform.salir()
				nodefault
				return .f.
			else
		
				** LUCHO M. 09-06-10
				if oApp.oTblParametros.Leer("AuditaFormularios") and type("oApp.oAUDITORIA") = "O"
					oApp.oAUDITORIA.AuditarCierreFormulario(oApp.CodUsuario(), oApp.Maquina, thisform.CodigoAuditoria, "QueryUnload")
				endif
				** LUCHO M. 09-06-10
		
				** Matías S. 08/06/16 **		
				thisform.grabarInputMaskInexistentes()
				** Matías S. 08/06/16 **
				return .t.
			endif
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE reestablecervalores
		local mmpp,cControlName,cControlValue
		for mmpp=1 to alen(thisform.ValoresViejos,1)
			cControlName=thisform.ValoresViejos[mmpp,1]
			cControlValue=thisform.ValoresViejos[mmpp,2]
			
			thisform.&cControlName..Value=cControlValue
		endfor
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarabmcabecera
		local mmpp,mcontrol,mcampo,mvaraux, vAuxiliar
		
		Dimension vAuxiliar[1]
		
		if type("thisform.pageframe1")=T_OBJECT
			
			for mmpp=1 to thisform.pageframe1.pagecount
				thisform.pageframe1.pages(mmpp).refresh
			endfor
		else
			thisform.refresh
		endif
		
		if !thisform.ModoAlta
			mcontrol=thisform.objetoclave
			mcampo=thisform.CampoClave
			if type("mControl")=T_CHARACTER
				&mcontrol..SetearValorInicial(&mcampo)
				thisform.oldVAlorClave=&mcampo
			endif	
		endif
		
		For mmpp=1 to 9
			if alltrim(thisform.vIntNavegacion[mmpp])<>""
				mvaraux=alltrim(thisform.vIntNavegacion[mmpp])
				&mvaraux
			Endif
		EndFor
		
		=acopy (thisform.vIntNavegacion, vAuxiliar)
		thisform.VerificarHabilitacionesControles(@vAuxiliar)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarmenuytool
		if type("oApp")=T_OBJECT.and.thisform.WindowType<>1
			oApp.RefrescarMenuYTool(thisform)
		endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE registrarcontrolavalidar
		lParameters oControlAValidar
		thisform.ControlAValidar=oControlAValidar
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE registrarobjeto
		lparameters mobjeto
		local multimo
		multimo=1
		if type("thisform.vobjetos[1]")=T_CHARACTER
			multimo=alen(thisform.vobjetos)+1
			dimension thisform.vobjetos[multimo]
		endif
		thisform.vobjetos[multimo]=mobjeto
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE removerbarventana
		if type("oApp")=T_OBJECT.and.thisform.WindowType<>1.and.thisform.BarraVentanaAgregada
			oApp.RemoverBarVentana(thisform.Caption)
			thisform.BarraVentanaAgregada=.f.	
		endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE removermenuytool
		if type("oApp")=T_OBJECT.and.thisform.WindowType<>1
			oApp.RemoverMenuYTool(thisform)
		endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Resize
		** Mati Sas 19/05/16 **
		If Type("This.mwResize1") = "O"
			this.mwResize1.Resize(This)
		Endif
		** Mati Sas 19/05/16 **
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE restaurartamanioform
		** Mati Sas 19/05/16 **
		LOCAL cForm, oTblTamanioForms
		
		oTblTamanioForms = createobject("Tg_tabla", "tamanioForms", "CLAVE")
		
		IF UPPER(ALLTRIM(thisform.Name)) <> UPPER(ALLTRIM("tg_fechausuario"))
		
			cForm = alltrim(thisform.name)
			if thisform.Instancias>1
				cForm=SUBSTR(alltrim(thisform.name),1,LEN(alltrim(thisform.name))-1)
			ENDIF
		
			If Type("This.mwResize1") = "O"
				thisform.mwResize1.SaveFormSize()
				IF oTblTamanioForms.buscar(UPPER(ALLTRIM(cForm)) + UPPER(ALLTRIM(oApp.codUsuario())), .F., "CLAVE")
					thisform.Width = oTblTamanioForms.leer("width")
					thisform.height = oTblTamanioForms.leer("height")
				ENDIF 
			ENDIF
		ENDIF 
		
		Release oTblTamanioForms
		** Mati Sas 19/05/16 **
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE restorewindowpos
		LPARAMETERS tcEntry
		LOCAL  lcBuffer, ;
		      lcOldError, ;
		      lnTop, ;
		      lnLeft, ;
		      llError, ;
		      lnCommaPos, ;
		      lcEntry
		      
		if type("oApp")=T_OBJECT
			IF PCOUNT() = 0
			  lcEntry = thisform.Caption
			ELSE
			  lcEntry = tcEntry
			ENDIF
		
			lcBuffer = SPACE(10) + CHR(0)
		
			lcOldError = ON('ERROR')
		
			*-- Leer la posición de la ventana desde el archivo INI
			
		*!*		IF GetPrivStr("WindowPositions", lcEntry, "", ;
		*!*	        	       @lcBuffer, LEN(lcBuffer), ;
		*!*	    	           CURDIR() + TG_INIFILE) > 0
		    	           
			IF GetPrivStr("WindowPositions", lcEntry, "", ;
		        	       @lcBuffer, LEN(lcBuffer), ;
		    	           oApp.ArchivoIni()) > 0
		    	           
			  *-- If an error occurs while parsing the string, 
			  *-- just ignore the string and use the form's 
			  *-- defaults
		  	
			  ON ERROR llError = .T.
			  lnCommaPos = AT(",", lcBuffer)
			  lnTop  = VAL(LEFT(lcBuffer, lnCommaPos - 1))
			  lnLeft = VAL(SUBSTR(lcBuffer, lnCommaPos + 1))
		  
			  ON ERROR &lcOldError
			  IF !llError
			    thisform.Top = lnTop
			    thisform.Left = lnLeft
			  ENDIF
			ENDIF
		ENDIF	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE revertir
		if type("thisform.oMaestro")=T_OBJECT
			this.oMaestro.revertir
			this.oMaestro.unlock		
			thisform.ModoEdicion=.f.
			if this.modoAlta
				this.modoAlta=.f.
				this.oMaestro.IrAnterior
			endif
			thisform.habilcontroles(this.modoedicion) 
			thisform.refrescarAbmCabecera
		endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE salir
		local mvaraux,mmpp,msalir
		msalir=.t.
		if type("thisform.oMaestro")=T_OBJECT
		
			thisform.EscribirBuffer
			
			if thisform.oMaestro.HayModificaciones().or.thisform.ModoAlta
				
				mretorna=fMensPregunto(TG_DESCARTACAMBIOS,"N",.t.)
				do case
					case mretorna="N"
						* msalir= thisform.oMaestro.Grabar()
						msalir= thisform.Grabar()				
					case mretorna="S"
						thisform.oMaestro.Revertir
						msalir=.t.
					otherwise
						msalir=.f.
				endcase
		
			endif
		endif
		
		*!*	if msalir	
		*!*		for mmpp=1 to alen(thisform.vobjetos)
		*!*			mvaraux=thisform.vobjetos[mmpp]
		*!*			if type("mvaraux")<>T_LOGICAL
		*!*				thisform.&mvaraux=""
		*!*			endif	
		*!*		endfor
		*!*	endif
		return msalir
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE savewindowpos
		LPARAMETERS tcEntry
		LOCAL lcValue, ;
		      lcEntry
		
		if type("oApp")=T_OBJECT
		
			IF PCOUNT() = 0
			  lcEntry = thisform.Caption
			ELSE
			  lcEntry = tcEntry
			ENDIF
		
			lcValue = ALLT(STR(MAX(thisform.Top, 0))) + ',' + ;
			          ALLT(STR(MAX(thisform.Left, 0)))
			*-- Escribir la entrada en el archivo INI
		
		*!*		=WritePrivStr("WindowPositions", lcEntry,lcValue, CURDIR() + TG_INIFILE)
			=WritePrivStr("WindowPositions", lcEntry,lcValue,oApp.ArchivoIni())
		             
		    ** Mati Sas 19/05/16 **
			thisform.grabarTamanioForm()
			** Mati Sas 19/05/16 **
		endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seleccionartodo
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearcaption
		lParameters cCaption
		local cCaptionRetorna
		thisform.RemoverBarVentana
		
		if thisform.instancias>1.and.thisform.NumeroInstanciaEnTitulo
			cCaptionRetorna=alltrim(cCaption)+" "+"("+alltrim(str(thisform.Instancias))+")"
		else
			cCaptionRetorna=alltrim(cCaption)
		endif
		if thisform.Instancias=1 or thisform.WindowType=1
			If thisform.TopLeftRegistrado
				thisform.restoreWindowpos(cCaptionRetorna)
			Endif
			If thisform.WindowType<>1		
			    if type("oApp")=T_OBJECT
			    	oApp.ActPosInstancia(thisform)
			    endif
			Endif    
		endif	
		thisform.caption=cCaptionRetorna	
		thisform.AgregarBarVentana
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearcursorespera
		thisform.MousePointer=11
	ENDPROC

				nHelp=2

				nHelp=3
			Case alltrim(upper(cId_Help))="LISTADOVENTAS"
				nHelp=10
			Case alltrim(upper(cId_Help))="LISTADOCOMPRAS"
				nHelp=16
			Case alltrim(upper(cId_Help))="LISTADOCAJA"
				nHelp=21
			Case alltrim(upper(cId_Help))="LISTADOCOMISIONES"

		return Empty(Dato)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validar

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE verificaredicion

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE verificarhabilitacionescontroles
		LParameters vCondiciones
		
		local mmpp, mcontrol, mvaraux, lIntNavega, cStringAux, cStringControl, nColorDeshabilita, cStringAux1
		
		lIntNavega = .f.
		if type("thisform.pageframe1")==T_OBJECT
			mvaraux="thisform.pageframe1"
		else
			mvaraux="thisform.page0"
		endif
		
		for z = 1 to alen(vCondiciones)
			if !EMPTY(vCondiciones[z])
				lIntNavega = .t.
			endif
		endfor	
		
		nColorDeshabilita = oApp.ColorAzul()
		
		if lIntNavega
			if !oApp.PerfilAdministrador() && en caso de tener PERFIL ADMINISTRADOR, todos los campos son EDITABLES
				if type("thisform.pageframe1")==T_OBJECT
					for j = 1 to thisform.pageframe1.PageCount
		
						cStringControl = 'thisform.pageframe1.Pages[j].' + 'Page' + alltrim(str(j)) + '.ControlCount'
		
						for i = 1 to &cStringControl
							mVarAux = 'thisform.pageframe1.Pages[j]' + '.Page' + alltrim(str(j))
							
							cStringAux = mVarAux + '.Controls[i].Name'
							cNombreControl = &cStringAux
						
							if UPPER(substr(cNombreControl,1,4)) = 'MLBL'  && es un lavel
								cCampoFinal = substr(cNombreControl, 5)
							else && es un control
				
								&& PREGUNTO SI ESTA EN ALGUNA CONDICION DE NAVEGACION DEL ABM
								for z = 1 to alen(vCondiciones)
									if at(UPPER(cNombreControl), UPPER(vCondiciones[z])) <> 0
										&& en caso de encontrar el string, analizo las condiciones de habuilitación por PERMISOS
										
										cStringAux = mVarAux + '.Controls[i].BaseClass'
										if UPPER(&cStringAux) = "COMMANDBUTTON"
											cCampoFinal = substr(cNombreControl, 1, len(alltrim(cNombreControl))-1)
										else
											cCampoFinal = substr(cNombreControl, 2)
										endif	
			
										*cClave = thisform.Tabla + cCampoFinal
		
										lNo_Visible      = oApp.PedirPermisoCamposAbm ('FLD', alltrim(UPPER(thisform.Tabla)), 'NO_VISIBLE',      alltrim(UPPER(cCampoFinal)))
										lVisible_Edit    = oApp.PedirPermisoCamposAbm ('FLD', alltrim(UPPER(thisform.Tabla)), 'VISIBLE_EDIT',    alltrim(UPPER(cCampoFinal)))
										lVisible_No_Edit = oApp.PedirPermisoCamposAbm ('FLD', alltrim(UPPER(thisform.Tabla)), 'VISIBLE_NO_EDIT', alltrim(UPPER(cCampoFinal)))
							
										if lNo_Visible
											cStringAux1 = mVarAux + '.Controls[i].class'
											cStringAux = mVarAux + '.Controls[i].baseclass'
											If   upper(&cStringAux)="COMMANDBUTTON" or upper(&cStringAux1)="TG_CHECKBOX"  && EN CASO DE SER UN checkbox, lo dejo NO VISIBLE
												cStringAux = 'thisform.pageframe1.Pages[j].' + 'Page' + alltrim(str(j)) + '.Controls[i].Visible'
												&cStringAux = .f.
											Else	 
												nColorDeshabilita = oApp.ColorAzul()
												cStringAux = mVarAux + '.Controls[i].class'
												If upper(&cStringAux)="TG_COMBOCHECKBOX"  && EN CASO DE SER UN combocheckbox, tengo un container, por lo que trabajo con el combo del container
													cStringAux  = 'thisform.pageframe1.Pages[j].' + 'Page' + alltrim(str(j)) + '.Controls[i].Tg_ComboBox1.DisabledBackColor'
													&cStringAux = nColorDeshabilita
													cStringAux  = 'thisform.pageframe1.Pages[j].' + 'Page' + alltrim(str(j)) + '.Controls[i].Tg_ComboBox1.DisabledForeColor'
													&cStringAux = nColorDeshabilita
													cStringAux  = 'thisform.pageframe1.Pages[j].' + 'Page' + alltrim(str(j)) + '.Controls[i].Tg_ComboBox1.Style'
													&cStringAux = 0
													&& en caso de ser un COMBOCHECKBOX, le doy valor .f. a la propiedad "HABILITOABM"
													cStringAux  = 'thisform.pageframe1.Pages[j].' + 'Page' + alltrim(str(j)) + '.Controls[i].HabilitoAbm'
													&cStringAux = .f.
												ELSE
													cStringAux  = 'thisform.pageframe1.Pages[j].' + 'Page' + alltrim(str(j)) + '.Controls[i].DisabledBackColor'
													&cStringAux = nColorDeshabilita
													cStringAux  = 'thisform.pageframe1.Pages[j].' + 'Page' + alltrim(str(j)) + '.Controls[i].DisabledForeColor'
													&cStringAux = nColorDeshabilita
										
													cStringAux = mVarAux + '.Controls[i].class'
													If upper(&cStringAux)="TG_COMBOBOX"  && EN CASO DE SER UN combocheckbox, tengo un container, por lo que trabajo con el combo del container
														cStringAux  = 'thisform.pageframe1.Pages[j].' + 'Page' + alltrim(str(j)) + '.Controls[i].Style'
														&cStringAux = 0
													endif	
												ENDIF	
								
												cStringAux = 'thisform.pageframe1.Pages[j].' + 'Page' + alltrim(str(j)) + '.Controls[i].Enabled'
												&cStringAux = .f.
		
												cStringAux = mVarAux + '.Controls[i].class'
												If upper(&cStringAux)="TG_COMBOCHECKBOX"
													cStringAux = 'thisform.pageframe1.Pages[j].' + 'Page' + alltrim(str(j)) + '.Controls[i].Tg_ComboBox1.Enabled'
													&cStringAux = .f.
													cStringAux = 'thisform.pageframe1.Pages[j].' + 'Page' + alltrim(str(j)) + '.Controls[i].Tg_CheckBox1.Enabled'
													&cStringAux = .f.
												ENDIF	
											Endif	
										else
											cStringAux = 'thisform.pageframe1.Pages[j].' + 'Page' + alltrim(str(j)) + '.Controls[i].Visible'
											&cStringAux = .t.
											*thisform.PageFrame1.Pages[j].Controls[i].Visible = .t.
									
											if lVisible_Edit  
												&& si es VISIBLE EDITABLE LO DEJO COMO ESTA, YA QUE SE PUEDE HABER DESHABILITADO POR LA CONDICION DE INTNAVEGACION
											else
												cStringAux = 'thisform.pageframe1.Pages[j].' + 'Page' + alltrim(str(j)) + '.Controls[i].Enabled'
												&cStringAux = .f.
												
												cStringAux = mVarAux + '.Controls[i].baseclass'
												If   upper(&cStringAux)="COMMANDBUTTON" 
													cStringAux = 'thisform.pageframe1.Pages[j].' + 'Page' + alltrim(str(j)) + '.Controls[i].Enabled'
													&cStringAux = .t.
													cStringAux = 'thisform.pageframe1.Pages[j].' + 'Page' + alltrim(str(j)) + '.Controls[i].HabilitoAbm'
													&cStringAux = .f.
												Endif
		
												cStringAux = mVarAux + '.Controls[i].class'
												If upper(&cStringAux)="TG_COMBOCHECKBOX"  && EN CASO DE SER UN combocheckbox, tengo un container, por lo que trabajo con el combo del container
													&& en caso de ser un COMBOCHECKBOX, le doy valor .f. a la propiedad "HABILITOABM"
													cStringAux  = 'thisform.pageframe1.Pages[j].' + 'Page' + alltrim(str(j)) + '.Controls[i].HabilitoAbm'
													&cStringAux = .f.
													cStringAux = 'thisform.pageframe1.Pages[j].' + 'Page' + alltrim(str(j)) + '.Controls[i].Tg_ComboBox1.Enabled'
													&cStringAux = .f.
													cStringAux = 'thisform.pageframe1.Pages[j].' + 'Page' + alltrim(str(j)) + '.Controls[i].Tg_CheckBox1.Enabled'
													&cStringAux = .f.
												endif
											endif
										endif
										exit  && en caso de HABER ANALIZADO EL CONTROL, LO HAGO UNA SOLA VEZ, POR LO QUE SALGO DEL BUCLE DE LOS VECTORES DE CONDICION DEL ABM
									ENDIF	
								endfor
							endif	
						endfor
					endfor	
				else
					for i = 1 to thisform.Page0.ControlCount
					
						cNombreControl = thisform.Page0.Controls[i].Name
					
						if UPPER(substr(cNombreControl,1,4)) = 'MLBL'  && es un lavel
							cCampoFinal = substr(cNombreControl, 5)
						else && es un control
							If  upper(thisform.Page0.Controls[i].Baseclass)="COMMANDBUTTON" && es un boton
								cCampoFinal = substr(cNombreControl, 1,len(alltrim(cNombreControl))-1)
							Else
								cCampoFinal = substr(cNombreControl, 2)
							Endif
		
							&& PREGUNTO SI ESTA EN ALGUNA CONDICION DE NAVEGACION DEL ABM
							for z = 1 to alen(vCondiciones)
								if at(UPPER(cNombreControl), UPPER(vCondiciones[z])) <> 0
									&& en caso de encontrar el string, analizo las condiciones de habuilitación por PERMISOS
					
									*cClave = thisform.Tabla + cCampoFinal
									lNo_Visible      = oApp.PedirPermisoCamposAbm ('FLD', alltrim(UPPER(thisform.Tabla)), 'NO_VISIBLE',      alltrim(UPPER(cCampoFinal)))
									lVisible_Edit    = oApp.PedirPermisoCamposAbm ('FLD', alltrim(UPPER(thisform.Tabla)), 'VISIBLE_EDIT',    alltrim(UPPER(cCampoFinal)))
									lVisible_No_Edit = oApp.PedirPermisoCamposAbm ('FLD', alltrim(UPPER(thisform.Tabla)), 'VISIBLE_NO_EDIT', alltrim(UPPER(cCampoFinal)))
					
									if lNo_Visible
										If upper(thisform.Page0.Controls[i].Baseclass) = "COMMANDBUTTON" or upper(thisform.Page0.Controls[i].Class) = "TG_CHECKBOX"
											thisform.Page0.Controls[i].Visible = .f. && es un boton
										else
								
											IF upper(thisform.Page0.Controls[i].Class) = "TG_COMBOCHECKBOX"  && trabajo de manera espacial con este CONTAINER
												thisform.Page0.Controls[i].Tg_ComboBox1.DisabledBackColor = nColorDeshabilita
												thisform.Page0.Controls[i].Tg_ComboBox1.DisabledForeColor = nColorDeshabilita
												thisform.Page0.Controls[i].Tg_ComboBox1.Style             = 0
												&& en caso de ser un COMBOCHECKBOX, le doy valor .f. a la propiedad "HABILITOABM"
												thisform.Page0.Controls[i].HabilitoAbm = .f.
							        		    thisform.Page0.Controls[i].Tg_ComboBox1.Enabled = .f.
												thisform.Page0.Controls[i].Tg_CheckBox1.Enabled = .f.
											else
												thisform.Page0.Controls[i].DisabledBackColor = nColorDeshabilita
												thisform.Page0.Controls[i].DisabledForeColor = nColorDeshabilita
			
												If upper(thisform.Page0.Controls[i].Class) = "TG_COMBOBOX"  && EN CASO DE SER UN combocheckbox, tengo un container, por lo que trabajo con el combo del container
													thisform.Page0.Controls[i].Style = 0
												endif	
											endif
											thisform.Page0.Controls[i].Enabled = .f.
								
											** EN CASO DE SER UN COMBO, MODIFICA LAS PROPIEDADES "DISABLEDITEMBACKCOLOR" Y "DISABLEDITEMFORECOLOR"
											If upper(thisform.Page0.Controls[i].baseclass)="COMBOBOX" 
												thisform.Page0.Controls[i].DisabledItemBackColor = nColorDeshabilita
												thisform.Page0.Controls[i].DisabledItemForeColor = nColorDeshabilita
											endif
										endif	
									else
										thisform.Page0.Controls[i].Visible = .t.
										if lVisible_Edit
											&& en caso de tener las opciones de HABILITACION, NO HAGO NADA
										else
											thisform.Page0.Controls[i].Enabled = .f.
											If  upper(thisform.Page0.Controls[i].Baseclass) = "COMMANDBUTTON"  
												thisform.Page0.Controls[i].Enabled = .t.
												thisform.Page0.Controls[i].HabilitoAbm = .f.
											Endif
											If upper(thisform.Page0.Controls[i].Class) = "TG_COMBOCHECKBOX"  && EN CASO DE SER UN combocheckbox, tengo un container, por lo que trabajo con el combo del container
												&& en caso de ser un COMBOCHECKBOX, le doy valor .f. a la propiedad "HABILITOABM"
												thisform.Page0.Controls[i].HabilitoAbm = .f.
												thisform.Page0.Controls[i].Tg_ComboBox1.Enabled = .f.
												thisform.Page0.Controls[i].Tg_CheckBox1.Enabled = .f.
											endif
										endif
									endif
									EXIT
								ENDIF
							ENDFOR
						endif	
					endfor
				endif
			endif	
		endif
		
		*thisform.refresh
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_timerBase.Timer
		Local oControlValidar
		
		this.CantidadVeces=this.CantidadVeces+1
		if this.CantidadVeces=1
		
			oControlAValidar=thisform.ControlAValidar
			if type("oControlAValidar")="O"
				if !IsNull(oControlAValidar)
					if !oControlAValidar.Enabled
						oControlAValidar.Enabled=.t.
					Endif
					if (type("oControlAValidar")="O") and (type("thisform.ActiveControl") <> "O" or oControlAValidar.Name<>thisform.ActiveControl.Name)
						oControlAValidar.SetFocus()
					Endif	
				endif
			endif		
			This.Enabled=.f.
			thisform.DesRegistrarControlAValidar
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

DEFINE CLASS tg_formset AS formset 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="formset" Timestamp="" Scale="" Uniqueid="" />

	*-- OBJECTDATA items order determines ZOrder / El orden de los items OBJECTDATA determina el ZOrder 
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Form1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />

	#INCLUDE "..\include\target.h"
	*<PropValue>
		Name = "tg_formset"
	*</PropValue>

	ADD OBJECT 'Form1' AS form WITH ;
		Caption = "Form1", ;
		DoCreate = .T., ;
		Name = "Form1"
		*< END OBJECT: BaseClass="form" />

ENDDEFINE

DEFINE CLASS tg_formviejo AS form 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="form" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	*-- OBJECTDATA items order determines ZOrder / El orden de los items OBJECTDATA determina el ZOrder 
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_timerBase" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />

	#INCLUDE "..\include\target.h"
	*<DefinedPropArrayMethod>
		*m: aceptar
		*m: activarmenuytool
		*m: agregar
		*m: agregarbarventana
		*m: agregarmenuytool
		*m: asignarobjeto
		*m: borrar
		*m: cancelar
		*m: crearyasignarobjeto
		*m: decrementarinstancia
		*m: desactivarmenuytool
		*m: desregistrarcontrolavalidar
		*m: desseleccionartodo
		*m: dessetearcursorespera
		*m: editar
		*m: escribirbuffer
		*m: esfinal
		*m: esprincipio
		*m: focoenclave
		*m: grabar
		*m: guardarvalores
		*m: habilcontroles
		*m: hayrenglonseleccionado
		*m: imprimircomprobante
		*m: incrementarinstancia
		*m: int_edicion
		*m: iranterior
		*m: irprimero
		*m: irsiguiente
		*m: irultimo
		*m: liberarobjetos
		*m: pruebagrabar
		*m: reestablecervalores
		*m: refrescarabmcabecera
		*m: refrescaraplicacion
		*m: refrescarmenuytool
		*m: registrarcontrolavalidar
		*m: registrarobjeto
		*m: removerbarventana
		*m: removermenuytool
		*m: restorewindowpos
		*m: revertir
		*m: salir
		*m: savewindowpos
		*m: seleccionartodo
		*m: setearcaption
		*m: setearcursorespera
		*m: setearhelpcontextid
		*m: vacio
		*m: validar
		*m: verificaredicion
		*m: verificarhabilitacionescontroles
		*p: agregabarraventana
		*p: barraventanaagregada
		*p: campoclave
		*p: controlavalidar
		*p: copias2
		*p: formdesactivado
		*p: formoldname
		*p: instancias
		*p: instanciasescalonadas
		*p: modoalta
		*p: modoedicion		&& Fi
		*p: numeroinstanciaentitulo
		*p: objetoclave
		*p: tipoformulario
		*p: topleftregistrado
		*p: yadecrementoinstancia
		*a: valoresviejos[1,2]
		*a: vintedicion[9,0]
		*a: vintnavegacion[9,0]
		*a: vobjetos[1,0]
	*</DefinedPropArrayMethod>

	*<PropValue>
		agregabarraventana = .T.
		BackColor = 192,192,192
		BorderStyle = 2
		Caption = "Form"
		controlavalidar = 
		copias2 = 0
		DataSession = 2
		DoCreate = .T.
		Height = 250
		Icon = ..\bmp\eif16.ico
		instancias = 0
		instanciasescalonadas = .T.
		Left = 0
		MaxButton = .F.
		Name = "tg_form"
		numeroinstanciaentitulo = .T.
		ShowTips = .T.
		tipoformulario = 
		Top = 0
		topleftregistrado = .T.
		Width = 375
	*</PropValue>

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_timerBase' AS tg_timer WITH ;
		cantidadveces = 0, ;
		Enabled = .F., ;
		Left = 348, ;
		Name = "Tg_timerBase", ;
		Top = 0
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="timer" />
	
	PROCEDURE aceptar
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE activarmenuytool
		if type("oApp")=T_OBJECT.and.thisform.WindowType<>1
			oApp.ActivarMenuYTool(thisform)
		endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Activate
		If Thisform.WindowState = 1 and .f.
			Thisform.WindowState = 0
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE agregar
		thisform.ModoAlta=.t.	
		thisform.ModoEdicion=.t.
		thisform.Omaestro.Agregar
		
		thisform.FocoEnClave
		thisform.refrescarAbmCabecera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE agregarbarventana
		if type("oApp")=T_OBJECT.and.thisform.WindowType<>1.and.!thisform.BarraVentanaAgregada.and.thisform.AgregaBarraVentana
			oApp.AgregarBarVentana(thisform)
			thisform.BarraVentanaAgregada=.t.
		endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE agregarmenuytool
		if type("oApp")=T_OBJECT.and.thisform.WindowType<>1
			oApp.AgregarMenuYTool(thisform)
		endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE asignarobjeto
		lParameters cDestino,cObjeto
		thisform.RegistrarObjeto(cDestino)
		&cDestino=cObjeto
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE borrar
		local mEvaluaBaja
		if type("this.oMaestro")=T_OBJECT
			if this.oMaestro.lockReg() and !this.oMaestro.borrado()
				mevaluabaja=fMensPregunto(TG_PREGUNTABAJA,"N",.f.)
				if mevaluabaja="S"
		
					this.oMaestro.Borrar
					this.oMaestro.IrAnterior
					
		
				endif
				this.oMaestro.unlock
				thisform.refrescarAbmCabecera
			endif	
		endif   
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cancelar
		if thisform.salir()
			thisform.release
			Return .t.
		Else
			Return .f.	
		endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE crearyasignarobjeto
		lParameters cDestino,cClase,nPar1,nPar2,nPar3,nPar4,nPar5,nPar6,nPar7,nPar8,nPar9,nPar10,nPar11,nPar12,nPar13,nPar14,nPar15
		Local mmpp,cParametros,cOperacion
		cParametros=""
		
		For mmpp=1 to parameters()-2
			cParametros=cParametros+",nPar"+Alltrim(str(mmpp))
		EndFor
		If cParametros<>""
			cParametros=substr(cParametros,2)
		Endif	
		cOperacion=cDestino+"=CreateObject('"+Alltrim(cCLase)+"'"+iif(parameters()-2>0,",","")+alltrim(cParametros)+")"
		
		thisform.RegistrarObjeto(cDestino)
		&cOperacion
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Deactivate
		thisform.DesactivarMenuYTool
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE decrementarinstancia
		if type("oApp")=T_OBJECT .and. thisform.WindowType<>1
			oApp.RemoveInstance(thisform.FormOldName)
		endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE desactivarmenuytool
		if type("oApp")=T_OBJECT.and.thisform.WindowType<>1
			oApp.DesactivarMenuYTool(thisform)
		endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE desregistrarcontrolavalidar
		thisform.ControlAValidar=""
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE desseleccionartodo
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE dessetearcursorespera
		thisform.MousePointer=0
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Destroy
		Local oAuxiliar,mVarAux
		*-- Hacer que el formulario desaparezca antes de hacer nada más
		
		thisform.ControlAValidar=""
		
		
		thisform.decrementarInstancia
		thisform.RemoverMenuYtool
		
		thisform.RemoverBarVentana
		thisform.LiberarObjetos
		
		*!*	thisform.Visible = .F.
			
		*-- Guardar la posición de la ventana en el archivo INI
		
		if thisform.instancias=1.and.thisform.TopLeftRegistrado
			thisform.SaveWindowPos()
		endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE editar
		Local mmpp,mVaraux,cCondicion,cComandoFalso,cComandoVerdadero
		if type("thisform.oMaestro")=T_OBJECT
		*!*		if  this.ModoAlta .or. (thisform.oMaestro.lockReg() and !thisForm.oMaestro.borrado())
				&& No lockeo registro ya que al grabar una factura intenta grabar ultima 
				&& operacion en el archivo de clientes y se pincha
		 	if  this.ModoAlta .or.  (!thisForm.oMaestro.borrado() and !thisform.oMaestro.EsTablaVacia())
		
				thisform.ModoEdicion=.T.
				thisform.habilcontroles(thisform.ModoEdicion) 
				thisform.Int_edicion		
		
		
			endif
		endif	
		return thisForm.ModoEdicion
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE escribirbuffer
		local lErrorAnt,lHayError,llREtVal
		lHayError=.f.
		llREtVal=.t.
		
		lErrorAnt=on('error')
		
		on error lHayError=.t.
		
		
		IF TYPE("thisform.ActiveControl") == "O" AND ;
		    UPPER(thisform.ActiveControl.BaseClass) <> "TG_GRID"
		 
		  IF TYPE("thisform.ActiveControl.ControlSource") <> "U" AND ;
		      !EMPTY(thisform.ActiveControl.ControlSource)
		
		    IF EVAL(thisform.ActiveControl.ControlSource) <> thisform.ActiveControl.Value
		      REPLACE (thisform.ActiveControl.ControlSource) WITH thisform.ActiveControl.Value in thisform.oMaestro.Alias
		      llRetVal = (EVAL(thisform.ActiveControl.ControlSource) = thisform.ActiveControl.Value)  	 		      
		    ENDIF
		  ENDIF
		ENDIF
		
		on error &lErrorAnt
		return llREtVal
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE esfinal
		return thisform.oMaestro.EsFinal()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE esprincipio
		return thisform.oMaestro.EsPrincipio()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE focoenclave
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE GotFocus
		if Type("thisform.ControlAValidar")=T_OBJECT
			thisform.tg_TimerBase.CantidadVeces=0
			thisform.tg_TimerBase.Enabled=.t.	
		Endif
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()
		thisform.ActivarMenuYTool
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabar
		local lGrabacionCorrecta,lHayError,lErrorAnt
		
		lHayError=.f.
		lGrabacionCorrecta=.f.
		if type("thisform.oMaestro")=T_OBJECT
		
				
				lHayError=!thisform.EscribirBuffer()
				
		
				
				lGrabacionCorrecta=thisform.Validar() .and.this.oMaestro.Grabar()
		
				if lGrabacionCorrecta
		
				    ** conmuta el edit
					this.ModoEdicion=.f.
					this.modoalta=.f.
					** pone enabled o disable los controles del form
					thisform.habilcontroles(this.modoedicion) 
				
				endif
		endif	
		
		return lGrabacionCorrecta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE guardarvalores
		Local mmpp,nCantControles
		nCantControles=1
		For mmpp=1 to Thisform.ControlCount
			if Type("thisform.Controls[mmpp].Value")<>T_UNDEFINED
				Dimension thisform.ValoresViejos[nCantControles,2]
				thisform.ValoresViejos[nCantControles,1]=Thisform.Controls[mmpp].Name
				thisform.ValoresViejos[nCantControles,2]=Thisform.Controls[mmpp].Value
				nCantControles=nCantControles+1
			endif	
		Endfor	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE habilcontroles
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE hayrenglonseleccionado
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Hide
		thisform.RemoverBarVentana
		thisform.LiberarObjetos
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE imprimircomprobante
		lParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nReferencia,nCopias,lConfImpresion
		
		
		
		If oApp.PedirPermiso('COM',cId_Comproba,'I',cId_Sistema)
			
			If Type("thisform.oCstImprimecomprobantes")<>T_OBJECT
				thisform.AddObject("oCstImprimecomprobantes","Tg_ImprimeComprobantes")
			Endif	
			thisform.oCstImprimecomprobantes.ImprimirComprobante(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_comproba,nReferencia,nCopias,lConfImpresion)
			
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE incrementarinstancia
		if type("oApp")=T_OBJECT and thisform.WindowType<>1
			thisform.instancias=oApp.addInstance(thisform)
			thisform.FormOldName=thisform.Name
			if thisform.Instancias>1
				thisform.Name=alltrim(thisform.name)+alltrim(str(thisform.Instancias))
				thisform.SetearCaption(thisform.caption)
			endif	
		endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		*-- Restaurar la posición de la ventana desde el archivo INI
		if type("thisform.TipoFormulario")=T_CHARACTER
			thisform.tipoFormulario=TG_TIPOFORMCOMUN
		endif	
		thisform.tg_timerBase.Enabled=.f.
		thisform.tg_timerBase.Interval=10
		*!*	thisform.addObject("oEnvironment","tg_environment")
		*!*	thisform.oEnvironment.Set()
		
		If thisform.TopLeftRegistrado
			thisform.RestoreWindowPos()	
		Endif	
		
		
		thisform.AgregarBarVentana
		thisform.IncrementarInstancia
		thisform.AgregarMenuYTool
			
		
		thisform.ModoEdicion=.f.
		
		*@409@*
		oApp.ControlarHabilitacionSistema()
		*@409@*
		
		oApp.ChequearVersion
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE int_edicion
		Local cCondicion,cComandoFalso,cComandoVerdadero,mmpp
		For mmpp=1 to 9
			if alltrim(thisform.vIntEdicion[mmpp])<>""
				cCondicion=fstrGenerico(alltrim(thisform.vIntEdicion[mmpp]),1,"**")
				cComandoVerdadero=fstrGenerico(alltrim(thisform.vIntEdicion[mmpp]),2,"**")
				cComandoFalso=fstrGenerico(alltrim(thisform.vIntEdicion[mmpp]),3,"**")
				If &cCondicion
					&cComandoVerdadero
				Else
					if alltrim(cComandoFalso)<>""
						&cComandoFalso
					Endif	
				Endif
			Endif
		EndFor
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE iranterior
		if type("thisform.oMaestro")=T_OBJECT
			if not thisform.oMaestro.EsBof()
				thisform.oMaestro.IrAnterior
			endif
		
			thisform.refrescarAbmCabecera
		endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE irprimero
		if type("thisform.oMaestro")=T_OBJECT
			thisform.oMaestro.IrPrimero
		
			thisform.refrescarAbmCabecera
		endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE irsiguiente
		if type("thisform.oMaestro")=T_OBJECT
			if not thisform.oMaestro.Eseof()
				thisform.oMaestro.IrSiguiente
			endif
		
			thisform.refrescarAbmCabecera
		endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE irultimo
		if type("thisform.oMaestro")=T_OBJECT
			thisform.oMaestro.IrUltimo
		
			thisform.refrescarAbmCabecera
		endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE liberarobjetos
		for mmpp=1 to alen(thisform.vobjetos)
			mvaraux=thisform.vobjetos[mmpp]
			if type("mVarAux")<>T_LOGICAL
				&mVarAux=3 &&..Destroy
			endif	
		endfor
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Load
		
		thisform.addObject("oEnvironment","tg_environment")
		thisform.oEnvironment.Set()
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE pruebagrabar
		IF EVAL(thisform.ActiveControl.ControlSource) <> thisform.ActiveControl.Value
			replace categorias.nombre with thisform.page0.mnombre.value
		Endif	
		
		lGrabacionExitosa=tableupdate(2,.t.,thisform.oMaestro.Alias)
		if !lgrabacionExitosa
		Endif
		
		return .t.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		if !thisform.salir()
			nodefault
			return .f.
		else
			return .t.
		endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE reestablecervalores
		local mmpp,cControlName,cControlValue
		for mmpp=1 to alen(thisform.ValoresViejos,1)
			cControlName=thisform.ValoresViejos[mmpp,1]
			cControlValue=thisform.ValoresViejos[mmpp,2]
			
			thisform.&cControlName..Value=cControlValue
		endfor
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarabmcabecera
		local mmpp,mcontrol,mcampo,mvaraux
		if type("thisform.pageframe1")=T_OBJECT
			
			for mmpp=1 to thisform.pageframe1.pagecount
				thisform.pageframe1.pages(mmpp).refresh
			endfor
		else
			thisform.refresh
		endif
		
		if !thisform.ModoAlta
			mcontrol=thisform.objetoclave
			mcampo=thisform.CampoClave
			if type("mControl")=T_CHARACTER
				&mcontrol..SetearValorInicial(&mcampo)
				thisform.oldVAlorClave=&mcampo
			endif	
		endif
		
		For mmpp=1 to 9
			if alltrim(thisform.vIntNavegacion[mmpp])<>""
				mvaraux=alltrim(thisform.vIntNavegacion[mmpp])
				&mvaraux
			Endif
		EndFor
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarmenuytool
		if type("oApp")=T_OBJECT.and.thisform.WindowType<>1
			oApp.RefrescarMenuYTool(thisform)
		endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE registrarcontrolavalidar
		lParameters oControlAValidar
		thisform.ControlAValidar=oControlAValidar
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE registrarobjeto
		lparameters mobjeto
		local multimo
		multimo=1
		if type("thisform.vobjetos[1]")=T_CHARACTER
			multimo=alen(thisform.vobjetos)+1
			dimension thisform.vobjetos[multimo]
		endif
		thisform.vobjetos[multimo]=mobjeto
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE removerbarventana
		if type("oApp")=T_OBJECT.and.thisform.WindowType<>1.and.thisform.BarraVentanaAgregada
			oApp.RemoverBarVentana(thisform.Caption)
			thisform.BarraVentanaAgregada=.f.	
		endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE removermenuytool
		if type("oApp")=T_OBJECT.and.thisform.WindowType<>1
			oApp.RemoverMenuYTool(thisform)
		endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE restorewindowpos
		LPARAMETERS tcEntry
		LOCAL  lcBuffer, ;
		      lcOldError, ;
		      lnTop, ;
		      lnLeft, ;
		      llError, ;
		      lnCommaPos, ;
		      lcEntry
		      
		if type("oApp")=T_OBJECT
			IF PCOUNT() = 0
			  lcEntry = thisform.Caption
			ELSE
			  lcEntry = tcEntry
			ENDIF
		
			lcBuffer = SPACE(10) + CHR(0)
		
			lcOldError = ON('ERROR')
		
			*-- Leer la posición de la ventana desde el archivo INI
			
		*!*		IF GetPrivStr("WindowPositions", lcEntry, "", ;
		*!*	        	       @lcBuffer, LEN(lcBuffer), ;
		*!*	    	           CURDIR() + TG_INIFILE) > 0
		    	           
			IF GetPrivStr("WindowPositions", lcEntry, "", ;
		        	       @lcBuffer, LEN(lcBuffer), ;
		    	           oApp.ArchivoIni()) > 0
		
		
		
		    	           
			  *-- If an error occurs while parsing the string, 
			  *-- just ignore the string and use the form's 
			  *-- defaults
		  	
			  ON ERROR llError = .T.
			  lnCommaPos = AT(",", lcBuffer)
			  lnTop  = VAL(LEFT(lcBuffer, lnCommaPos - 1))
			  lnLeft = VAL(SUBSTR(lcBuffer, lnCommaPos + 1))
		  
			  ON ERROR &lcOldError
			  IF !llError
			    thisform.Top = lnTop
			    thisform.Left = lnLeft
			  ENDIF
			ENDIF
		ENDIF	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE revertir
		if type("thisform.oMaestro")=T_OBJECT
			this.oMaestro.revertir
			this.oMaestro.unlock		
			thisform.ModoEdicion=.f.
			if this.modoAlta
				this.modoAlta=.f.
				this.oMaestro.IrAnterior
			endif
			thisform.habilcontroles(this.modoedicion) 
			thisform.refrescarAbmCabecera
		endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE salir
		local mvaraux,mmpp,msalir
		msalir=.t.
		if type("thisform.oMaestro")=T_OBJECT
		
			thisform.EscribirBuffer
			
			if thisform.oMaestro.HayModificaciones().or.thisform.ModoAlta
				
				mretorna=fMensPregunto(TG_DESCARTACAMBIOS,"N",.t.)
				do case
					case mretorna="N"
						* msalir= thisform.oMaestro.Grabar()
						msalir= thisform.Grabar()				
					case mretorna="S"
						thisform.oMaestro.Revertir
						msalir=.t.
					otherwise
						msalir=.f.
				endcase
		
			endif
		endif
		
		*!*	if msalir	
		*!*		for mmpp=1 to alen(thisform.vobjetos)
		*!*			mvaraux=thisform.vobjetos[mmpp]
		*!*			if type("mvaraux")<>T_LOGICAL
		*!*				thisform.&mvaraux=""
		*!*			endif	
		*!*		endfor
		*!*	endif
		return msalir
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE savewindowpos
		LPARAMETERS tcEntry
		LOCAL lcValue, ;
		      lcEntry
		
		if type("oApp")=T_OBJECT
		
			IF PCOUNT() = 0
			  lcEntry = thisform.Caption
			ELSE
			  lcEntry = tcEntry
			ENDIF
		
			lcValue = ALLT(STR(MAX(thisform.Top, 0))) + ',' + ;
			          ALLT(STR(MAX(thisform.Left, 0)))
			*-- Escribir la entrada en el archivo INI
		
		*!*		=WritePrivStr("WindowPositions", lcEntry,lcValue, CURDIR() + TG_INIFILE)
				=WritePrivStr("WindowPositions", lcEntry,lcValue,oApp.ArchivoIni())
		             
		endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seleccionartodo
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearcaption
		lParameters cCaption
		local cCaptionRetorna
		thisform.RemoverBarVentana
		
		if thisform.instancias>1.and.thisform.NumeroInstanciaEnTitulo
			cCaptionRetorna=alltrim(cCaption)+" "+"("+alltrim(str(thisform.Instancias))+")"
		else
			cCaptionRetorna=alltrim(cCaption)
		endif
		if thisform.Instancias=1 or thisform.WindowType=1
			If thisform.TopLeftRegistrado
				thisform.restoreWindowpos(cCaptionRetorna)
			Endif
			If thisform.WindowType<>1		
			    if type("oApp")=T_OBJECT
			    	oApp.ActPosInstancia(thisform)
			    endif
			Endif    
		endif	
		thisform.caption=cCaptionRetorna	
		thisform.AgregarBarVentana
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearcursorespera
		thisform.MousePointer=11
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearhelpcontextid
		lParameters cId_Help
		Local nHelp
		nHelp=0
		
		Do Case
			Case alltrim(upper(cId_Help))="CONSULTA"
				nHelp=9
			Case alltrim(upper(cId_Help))="CONSULTACOMPRAS"

	PROCEDURE Tg_timerBase.Timer
		Local oControlValidar
		
		this.CantidadVeces=this.CantidadVeces+1
		if this.CantidadVeces=1
		
			oControlAValidar=thisform.ControlAValidar
			if type("oControlAValidar")="O"
				if !IsNull(oControlAValidar)
					if !oControlAValidar.Enabled
						oControlAValidar.Enabled=.t.
					Endif
					if type("thisform.ActiveControl") <> "O" or oControlAValidar.Name<>thisform.ActiveControl.Name
						oControlAValidar.SetFocus()
					Endif	
				endif
			endif		
			This.Enabled=.f.
			thisform.DesRegistrarControlAValidar
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

DEFINE CLASS tg_grid AS grid 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="grid" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	#INCLUDE "..\include\target.h"
	*<DefinedPropArrayMethod>
		*m: cargargrilla
		*m: clickheader
		*m: dblclickencelda
		*m: dblclickheader
		*m: dblclickheaderconsulta
		*m: especificarfont
		*m: mantclick		&& aa
		*m: mantenerclick
		*m: ordenar
		*m: refrescarrenglon
		*m: resaltarrenglon
		*m: resizeheader
		*m: rightclickceldaconsulta		&& rightclick
		*m: rightclickencelda
		*m: rightclickheaderconsulta
		*p: formbase
		*p: oconfiggrilla
		*p: recno
		*p: registro
		*p: resaltarenglon
		*a: vanchocolumnas[1,0]
	*</DefinedPropArrayMethod>

	*<PropValue>
		DeleteMark = .F.
		FontBold = .F.
		FontName = "MS Sans Serif"
		FontSize = 8
		formbase = .F.
		Highlight = .F.
		Name = "tg_grid"
		RowHeight = 16
		Themes = .T.
		Width = 320
	*</PropValue>
	
	PROCEDURE cargargrilla
		Lparameters vDatos
		Local mmpp,cAux
		For mmpp=1 to Alen(vDatos,1)
			cAux="this."+Alltrim(vDatos(mmpp,3))+".Width=vDatos(mmpp,1)"
			&cAux
			cAux="this."+Alltrim(vDatos(mmpp,3))+".ColumnOrder=vDatos(mmpp,2)"
			&cAux	
		EndFor
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE clickheader
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE dblclickencelda
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE dblclickheader
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE dblclickheaderconsulta
		Lparameters cNombreColumna
		Local cAux,cCampo,cAliasAnt
		
		** VERSION NUEVA
		cAliasAnt=ALIAS()
		** VERSION NUEVA
		
		cAux="This."+Alltrim(cNombreColumna)+".Controlsource"
		cCampo=&cAux
		If At(".",cCampo)>0
			cCampo=Substr(cCampo,At(".",cCampo)+1)
		EndIf
		This.oConfigGrilla.Campo=cCampo
		This.oConfigGrilla.Ascendente=!This.oConfigGrilla.Ascendente
		This.Refresh()
		
		
		** VERSION NUEVA
		IF !EMPTY(cAliasAnt)
			SELECT (cAliasAnt)
		Endif
		** VERSION NUEVA
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE especificarfont
		** VERSION NUEVA
		Local mmpp
		For mmpp=1 to this.ColumnCount
			For mmmppp=1 to this.Columns(mmpp).ControlCount
				If Alltrim(Upper(this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).Class))=Upper("Header") or; && RODOLFO, RODOLFO 09-02-2007, SE AGREGA ESTO PARA QUE TOME BIEN EL FONT
					Alltrim(Upper(this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).Class))=Upper("Tg_Header")
					this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).FontBold=.f.
					this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).BackColor=Rgb(192,192,192)
		*			this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).BackColor=Rgb(227,239,251)
		*			this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).BackColor=Rgb(242,243,214)						
		*			this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).ForeColor=Rgb(255,255,255)
					this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).ForeColor=Rgb(0,0,0)			
				Endif	
			EndFor
		EndFor
		** VERSION NUEVA
		
		
		
		*!*	Local mmpp
		*!*	For mmpp=1 to this.ColumnCount
		*!*		For mmmppp=1 to this.Columns(mmpp).ControlCount
		*!*			If Alltrim(Upper(this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).Class))=Upper("Header") or; && RODOLFO, RODOLFO 09-02-2007, SE AGREGA ESTO PARA QUE TOME BIEN EL FONT
		*!*				Alltrim(Upper(this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).Class))=Upper("Tg_Header")
		*!*				this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).FontBold=.f.
		*!*				this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).BackColor=Rgb(128,128,128)
		*!*				this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).ForeColor=Rgb(255,255,255)			
		*!*			Endif	
		*!*		EndFor
		*!*	EndFor
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		Local mmpp,vDatos(1)
		Local lAlignment,nBackColor ,cCaption,cFontBold ,cFontCharSet,lFontCondense,lFontExtend
		Local lFontItalic,cFontName,cFontOutline ,cFontShadow,nFontSize,lFontStrikeThru ,lFontUnderline,nForeColor
		Local cPicture,cStatusBarText,cToolTipText,lWordWrap     
		
		** VERSION NUEVA
		LOCAL oGrid
		cAliasAnt=ALIAS()  
		** VERSION NUEVA
		
		If Type("ThisForm.EsConsultaGrid")="L" and Thisform.EsConsultaGrid
			For mmpp=1 to this.ColumnCount
				
				
				
				
				Dimension this.vAnchoColumnas[mmpp]
				this.vAnchoColumnas[mmpp]=this.Columns(mmpp).Width
				
				lAlignment=this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.Alignment
				nBackColor =this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.BackColor 
				cCaption=this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.Caption
				cFontBold =this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontBold 
				lFontCondense=this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontCondense
				lFontExtend =this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontExtend 
				lFontItalic=this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontItalic
				cFontName=this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontName
				cFontOutline =this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontOutline 
				cFontShadow=this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontShadow
				nFontSize=this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontSize
				lFontStrikeThru =this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontStrikeThru 
				lFontUnderline=this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontUnderline
				nForeColor=this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.ForeColor
				This.Columns(mmpp).AddObject("Header2","tg_Header")
				This.Columns(mmpp).Header2.Name="Header1"
				this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.Alignment=lAlignment
				this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.BackColor =nBackColor 
				this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.Caption=cCaption
				this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontBold =cFontBold 
				this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontCondense=lFontCondense
				this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontExtend =lFontExtend
				this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontItalic=lFontItalic
				this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontName=cFontName
				this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontOutline=cFontOutline 
				this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontShadow=cFontShadow
				this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontSize=nFontSize
				this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontStrikeThru=lFontStrikeThru  
				This.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontUnderline=lFontUnderline
				this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.ForeColor=nForeColor
		
			** VERSION NUEVA
			EndFor
			This.oConfigGrilla=CreateObject("tg_ConfigGrid",oApp.Usuario,Thisform.Class,@vDatos)
			
			If Type("vDatos")<>"L"
			
			
			    ** Gustavo 22/06/22 si el resize esta desactivado cargo la grilla aca de lo contrario en tg_form despues de agrandar o achicar el formulario
			   
				*IF !oApp.oTblParametros.ExisteCampo("ResizerDesActivado") or  oApp.oTblParametros.Leer("ResizerDesActivado")	
		
			    	This.CargarGrilla(@vDatos)
				*endif   
				** Gustavo 22/06/22
			
			ENDIF
		Else
			For mmpp=1 to this.ColumnCount
				Dimension this.vAnchoColumnas[mmpp]
				this.vAnchoColumnas[mmpp]=this.Columns(mmpp).Width
			EndFor
		ENDIF
			
		** ML 1807 24/9/24 Se agrego al if de abajo ---AND TYPE("interlineadogrilla")="N"---
		
		If Type("ThisForm.interlineado")="L" and Thisform.interlineado AND TYPE("interlineadogrilla")="N"
			this.setall("dynamicbackcolor","iif(Mod(interlineadogrilla,2)=0 and interlineadogrilla<>0,rgb(252,252,252),rgb(239,242,250))","column")
		ENDIF
					
		this.Recno=1
		this.EspecificarFont
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE KeyPress
		LPARAMETERS nKeyCode, nShiftAltCtrl
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mantclick		&& aa
		* tg_grid.mantClick
		LPARAMETERS tcEvent, tnButton, tnShift, tnX, tnY
		* tcEvent: 'down' | 'up' | 'move' | 'timer'
		LOCAL o, nTol
		o    = This
		nTol = 8    && tolerancia de movimiento en px
		
		*------------------------------------------
		* Inicialización (una sola vez, y segura)
		*------------------------------------------
		IF TYPE('o.lMantInit') # 'L'
		    o.AddProperty('lMantInit', .F.)
		ENDIF
		
		IF NOT o.lMantInit
		    * Props internas del grid
		    IF TYPE('o.lPressing')   # 'L'  o.AddProperty('lPressing',   .F.)
		    IF TYPE('o.lTriggered')  # 'L'  o.AddProperty('lTriggered',  .F.)
		    IF TYPE('o.nDownX')      # 'N'  o.AddProperty('nDownX',       0)
		    IF TYPE('o.nDownY')      # 'N'  o.AddProperty('nDownY',       0)
		    IF TYPE('o.nDownRow')    # 'N'  o.AddProperty('nDownRow',     0)
		    IF TYPE('o.nDownCol')    # 'N'  o.AddProperty('nDownCol',     0)
		
		    * Timer a nivel FORM
		    IF TYPE('Thisform') = 'O'
		        IF TYPE('Thisform.tmLongPress') # 'O'
		            Thisform.AddObject('tmLongPress','Timer')
		            Thisform.tmLongPress.Interval = 1000   && 1 segundo
		            Thisform.tmLongPress.Enabled  = .F.
		            * Cuando dispare el timer, vuelve a entrar a ESTE método sin params
		            BINDEVENT(Thisform.tmLongPress, 'Timer', o, 'mantClick')
		        ENDIF
		    ENDIF
		
		    o.lMantInit = .T.
		    RETURN   && primera llamada solo inicializa
		ENDIF
		
		*------------------------------------------
		* Dispatcher de eventos
		*------------------------------------------
		IF PCOUNT() = 0
		    * Evento TIMER
		    IF o.lPressing AND NOT o.lTriggered
		        o.lTriggered = .T.
		        IF TYPE('Thisform.tmLongPress') = 'O'
		            Thisform.tmLongPress.Enabled = .F.
		        ENDIF
		
		        * >>> LONG PRESS DETECTADO <<<
		        SET STEP ON   && acá te frena el debug
		        * (luego acá adentro vas a hacer lo que toque)
		    ENDIF
		    RETURN
		ENDIF
		
		DO CASE
		    CASE tcEvent = 'down'
		        IF tnButton = 1
		            o.lPressing  = .T.
		            o.lTriggered = .F.
		            o.nDownX     = tnX
		            o.nDownY     = tnY
		            o.nDownRow   = o.ActiveRow
		            o.nDownCol   = o.ActiveColumn
		            IF TYPE('Thisform.tmLongPress') = 'O'
		                Thisform.tmLongPress.Enabled = .T.
		            ENDIF
		        ENDIF
		
		    CASE tcEvent = 'move'
		        IF o.lPressing
		            IF ABS(tnX-o.nDownX) > nTol OR ABS(tnY-o.nDownY) > nTol
		                * Se considera drag ? cancelar
		                o.lPressing = .F.
		                IF TYPE('Thisform.tmLongPress') = 'O'
		                    Thisform.tmLongPress.Enabled = .F.
		                ENDIF
		            ENDIF
		        ENDIF
		
		    CASE tcEvent = 'up'
		        IF o.lPressing
		            * Soltó antes del umbral ? cancelar
		            o.lPressing = .F.
		            IF TYPE('Thisform.tmLongPress') = 'O'
		                Thisform.tmLongPress.Enabled = .F.
		            ENDIF
		        ENDIF
		ENDCASE
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mantenerclick
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE MouseDown
		LPARAMETERS nButton, nShift, nXCoord, nYCoord
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ordenar
		Local cCampoOrden,oTabla,lSalir,mmpp,oControl,vcontrolSourceColumnas(This.ColumnCount),cAliasAnt
		lSalir=.F.
		mmpp=1
		
		** VERSION NUEVA
		cAliasAnt=ALIAS()    
		** VERSION NUEVA
		
		if !empty(this.RecordSource)
			DO While !lSalir and mmpp<=Thisform.ControlCount
				oControl=Thisform.Controls(mmpp)
				If (Upper(oControl.Class)="TG_TABLA" or Upper(oControl.ParentClass)="TG_VIEW") and Upper(oControl.Alias)=Upper(This.RecordSource)
					oTabla=oControl
					lSalir=.T.
					Release oControl
				EndIf
				mmpp=mmpp+1
			EndDo
			If !oTabla.EsTablaVacia()
				For mmpp=1 to This.ColumnCount
					vcontrolSourceColumnas[mmpp]=This.Columns(mmpp).ControlSource
				EndFor
				This.RecordSource=""
				This.oConfigGrilla.OrdenarGrilla(oTabla)
				oTabla.IrPrimero()
				This.RecordSource=oTabla.Alias
				For mmpp=1 to This.ColumnCount
					This.Columns(mmpp).ControlSource=vcontrolSourceColumnas[mmpp]
				EndFor
			Endif
		endif	
		
		** VERSION NUEVA
		IF !EMPTY(cAliasAnt)
			SELECT (cAliasAnt)
		Endif
		** VERSION NUEVA
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarrenglon
		this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Refresh
		
		
		** VERSION NUEVA
		LOCAL cAliasAnt,nConta
		** Matías S. 08/06/16 **
		LOCAL vEstructuraTabla, nDecimalesCampo, nAnchoCampo, nCampoArray, nColumna, nObjetoColumna,lEsView,j,cAliasAntMetodo,cAliasAntCursorVista,cAliasAntSeparadorMiles,nRegAnt
		DIMENSION vEstructuraTabla[1,2]
		** Matías S. 08/06/16 **
		*** Matias L. 20/07/2023 #1619
		LOCAL lFormateado
		*** Matias L. 20/07/2023 #1619
		
		*** Matias L. 06/10/2023 #1682
		LOCAL oTblInputMaskIncompletas
		*** Matias L. 06/10/2023 #1682
		
		LOCAL nRecno,cPath,cTargetDbc
		
		cAliasAntMetodo=Alias()
		
		
		
		
		If !empty(this.RecordSource) 
			this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource)
		
			If Type("ThisForm.EsConsultaGrid")="L" and Thisform.EsConsultaGrid
				If !Empty(This.oConfigGrilla.Campo)
					This.Ordenar()
				Endif
			ENDIF
		
			nconta=1
			cAliasant = SELECT()
		
			SELECT (this.RecordSource)
		
			IF TYPE("interlineadogrilla") = "N"
				DO WHILE NOT EOF(this.RecordSource)
					Replace interlineadogrilla WITH nconta IN (this.RecordSource)
					nconta = 1 + nconta
					SKIP IN (this.RecordSource)
				ENDDO
			Endif	
				
			If Type("ThisForm.EsConsultaGrid")="L" and Thisform.EsConsultaGrid		
				GO TOP IN (this.RecordSource)
			Endif
			
			IF !EMPTY(cAliasant)
			    SELECT (cAliasant)
			Endif
			
		ENDIF
		
		
		
		
		
		&& Gustavo 13_01_2024 
		
		lEsView=.f.
		
		
		
		cAliasAntCursorVista=ALIAS()
			
			
		
		
		cPath=ALLTRIM(oApp.DirDatos)
		
		IF RIGHT(cPath,1)<>"\"
		   	cPath=cPath+"\"
		Endif
		
		cTargetDbc=cPath+"Target.dbc"
		
		
		SELECT objecttype From (cTargetdbc)  WHERE ALLTRIM(UPPER(objectname))=ALLTRIM(UPPER(this.RecordSource)) AND ALLTRIM(UPPER(ObjectType))="VIEW" INTO CURSOR CursorVistas
		
		
		
		if _tally>0
		
		  
		 * IF  ALLTRIM(UPPER(CursorVistas.ObjectType))="VIEW"
		
		  
		   	lEsView=.t.
		   
		 * Endif 
		   
		endif 
		
		IF !EMPTY(cAliasAntCursorVista)
		
			SELECT (cAliasAntCursorVista)
		
		ENDIF
		
		
		&& Gustavo 13_01_2024 
		
		
		** VERSION NUEVA
		** Matías S. 08/06/16 **
		IF oApp.oTblParametros.leer("separadorMiles") AND !EMPTY(this.RecordSource)   and (CURSORGETPROP("Buffering",this.RecordSource)=5 OR lEsView) && Gustavo 13_01_2024 
			
			
		
			cAliasAntSeparadorMiles = ALIAS()
			SELECT(this.RecordSource)
			
			
			nRegAnt=RECNO()
			
		
			
			IF EOF(this.RecordSource)
				nRegAnt=nRegAnt-1
			ENDIF
			
			
			
			GO TOP IN (this.RecordSource)
			
		
			
			IF !EOF(this.RecordSource)
				*** Matias L. 19/05/2023 #1619
			
		
		
				IF !EMPTY(this.RecordSource) 
					AFIELDS(vEstructuraTabla, this.RecordSource)
					
		
					*** Matias L. 19/05/2023 #1619
					FOR nColumna = 1 TO this.ColumnCount
						
		
		
		*************************************** COMENTADO **************************
						*IF !lFormateado
						IF EMPTY(this.columns[nColumna].inputmask)
							nCampoArray = ASCAN(vEstructuraTabla, UPPER(ALLTRIM(SUBSTR(this.Columns[nColumna].controlSource, AT(".", this.Columns[nColumna].controlSource)+1))),-1,-1,1,8)
							IF nCampoArray <= ALEN(vEstructuraTabla,1) AND nCampoArray > 0
								nAnchoCampo	= vEstructuraTabla[nCampoArray,3]
								nDecimalesCampo = vEstructuraTabla[nCampoArray,4]
								this.columns[nColumna].inputmask = oApp.formatearInputMask(oApp.armarInputMask(nAnchoCampo, nDecimalesCampo, vEstructuraTabla[nCampoArray,2],this.columns[nColumna].parentClass))
							ENDIF 
						ENDIF
		
		*************************************** COMENTADO **************************
						*** Gustavo 29/01/2024
						
						IF  AT("REFERE",UPPER(this.columns[nColumna].ControlSource))>0
							this.columns[nColumna].inputmask ="9999999999"
						Endif		
									
						*** Gustavo 29/01/2024
						
						*** Matias L. 06/10/2023 #1682
						lFormateado = .f.
						*** Matias L. 06/10/2023 #1682
					endfor
					*** Matias L. 19/05/2023 #1619
		
					&& Gustavo 13_01_2024 
		
					FOR nColumna = 1 TO this.ColumnCount
						
						FOR j = 1 TO this.Columns(nColumna).objects.count
							IF   ALLTRIM(UPPER(this.Columns(nColumna).Objects(j).Baseclass))="TEXTBOX"	
							 
						       this.Columns(nColumna).Objects(j).InputMask=this.Columns(nColumna).InputMask		
						       *** Gustavo 29/01/2024
						
									IF  AT("REFERE",UPPER(this.columns[nColumna].Objects(j).ControlSource))>0
										this.columns[nColumna].Objects(j).inputmask ="9999999999"
									Endif		
									
							  *** Gustavo 29/01/2024
						    ENDIF   		        
						ENDFOR 
						
					ENDFOR 
					
		
					&& Gustavo 13_01_2024 
		
				ENDIF 
			ENDIF 
			
			&& Gustavo 4/4/2024
			
			SELECT(this.RecordSource)
			IF nRegant>0 OR (CURSORGETPROP("BUFFERING",this.RecordSource)=5 AND nRegAnt<>0)
				GO nRegAnt
			Endif	
			
			IF !EMPTY(cAliasAntSeparadorMiles)
				SELECT (cAliasAntSeparadorMiles)
			Endif	
		ENDIF 
		
		
		
		** Matías S. 08/06/16 **
		
		IF !EMPTY(cAliasAntMetodo)
			SELECT (cAliasAntMetodo)
		Endif	
		
		
		
		this.EspecificarFont
		
		
		
		
		*************************************************************************************************************************************
		*!*	** VERSION NUEVA
		*!*	LOCAL cAliasAnt,nConta
		*!*	** Matías S. 08/06/16 **
		*!*	LOCAL vEstructuraTabla, nDecimalesCampo, nAnchoCampo, nCampoArray, nColumna, nObjetoColumna
		*!*	DIMENSION vEstructuraTabla[1,2]
		*!*	** Matías S. 08/06/16 **
		
		*!*	*** Matias L. 20/07/2023 #1619
		*!*	LOCAL lFormateado
		*!*	*** Matias L. 20/07/2023 #1619
		
		*!*	*** Matias L. 06/10/2023 #1682
		*!*	LOCAL oTblInputMaskIncompletas
		*!*	*** Matias L. 06/10/2023 #1682
		
		*!*	LOCAL nRecno
		
		*!*	cAliasAnt=ALIAS()
		
		*!*	*!*	nRecno = 0
		
		*!*	*!*	If !empty(this.RecordSource) 
		*!*	*!*		nRecno = recno(this.RecordSource)
		*!*	*!*	ENDIF
		
		
		*!*	If !empty(this.RecordSource) 
		*!*		this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource)
		
		*!*		If Type("ThisForm.EsConsultaGrid")="L" and Thisform.EsConsultaGrid
		*!*			If !Empty(This.oConfigGrilla.Campo)
		*!*				This.Ordenar()
		*!*			Endif
		*!*		ENDIF
		
		*!*		nconta=1
		*!*		cAliasant = SELECT()
		
		*!*		SELECT (this.RecordSource)
		
		*!*		IF TYPE("interlineadogrilla") = "N"
		*!*			DO WHILE NOT EOF(this.RecordSource)
		*!*				Replace interlineadogrilla WITH nconta IN (this.RecordSource)
		*!*				nconta = 1 + nconta
		*!*				SKIP IN (this.RecordSource)
		*!*			ENDDO
		*!*		Endif	
		*!*			
		*!*		If Type("ThisForm.EsConsultaGrid")="L" and Thisform.EsConsultaGrid		
		*!*			GO TOP IN (this.RecordSource)
		*!*		Endif
		*!*		
		*!*	Endif
		
		
		*!*	** VERSION NUEVA
		
		*!*	** Matías S. 08/06/16 **
		*!*	IF oApp.oTblParametros.leer("separadorMiles") AND !EMPTY(this.RecordSource)
		
		*!*		cAliasAnt = SELECT()
		*!*		SELECT(this.RecordSource)
		*!*		&&GO TOP IN (this.RecordSource)
		*!*		
		*!*		IF !EOF(this.RecordSource)
		*!*			*** Matias L. 19/05/2023 #1619
		*!*		
		*!*	*!*			FOR nColumna = 1 TO this.columnCount
		*!*	*!*				FOR nObjetoColumna = 1 TO this.columns[nColumna].controlCount
		*!*	*!*					IF TYPE("this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask") = "C" AND !EMPTY(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask)
		*!*	*!*						IF LEN(CHRTRAN(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask), "01234567989.", "")) = 0 && VAL(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask)) <> 0
		*!*	*!*							this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask = oApp.formatearInputMask(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask))
		*!*	*!*						ENDIF 
		*!*	*!*					ENDIF 
		*!*	*!*					
		*!*	*!*					IF !EMPTY(this.columns[nColumna].inputmask)
		*!*	*!*						IF LEN(CHRTRAN(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].inputmask), "01234567989.", "")) = 0 &&VAL(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].inputmask)) <> 0
		*!*	*!*							this.columns[nColumna].inputmask = oApp.formatearInputMask(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].inputmask))
		*!*	*!*						ENDIF 
		*!*	*!*					ENDIF 			
		*!*	*!*				ENDFOR 
		*!*	*!*			ENDFOR
		
		
		*!*			IF !EMPTY(this.RecordSource)
		*!*				AFIELDS(vEstructuraTabla, this.RecordSource)
		*!*				*** Matias L. 19/05/2023 #1619
		*!*				FOR nColumna = 1 TO this.ColumnCount
		*!*					
		*!*	*!*					FOR nObjetoColumna = 1 TO this.columns[nColumna].controlCount
		*!*						
		*!*						** Matias L. 01/11/2023 #1682 Se toma siempre lo que tenga el inputMask de la tabla
		*!*						*thisform.cargarinputmaskdelcontrol(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna], this.Name, "column" + ALLTRIM(STR(nColumna)))
		*!*					
		*!*	*!*						IF TYPE("this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask") = "C" AND !EMPTY(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask)
		*!*	*!*							IF LEN(CHRTRAN(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask), "01234567989.,", "")) = 0 && VAL(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask)) <> 0
		*!*	*!*							*	this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask = oApp.formatearInputMask(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask))
		*!*	*!*								lFormateado = .t.
		*!*	*!*							ENDIF 
		*!*	*!*						ENDIF 
		*!*	*!*						
		*!*	*!*						IF !EMPTY(this.columns[nColumna].inputmask)
		*!*	*!*							IF LEN(CHRTRAN(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].inputmask), "01234567989.,", "")) = 0 &&VAL(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].inputmask)) <> 0
		*!*	*!*								*this.columns[nColumna].inputmask = oApp.formatearInputMask(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].inputmask))
		*!*	*!*								lFormateado = .t.
		*!*	*!*							ENDIF 
		*!*	*!*						ENDIF
		*!*						
		*!*						*** Matias L. 06/10/2023 #1682
		*!*	*!*						IF !lFormateado && si no se formateo voy a buscar el objeto a la tabla InputMaskIncompletas y traigo cual es el ultimo inputMask que tenia
		
		*!*	*!*							thisform.cargarinputmaskdelcontrol(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna], this.Name, "column" + ALLTRIM(STR(nColumna)))
		*!*	*!*							lFormateado = .t.
		*!*	*!*						endif
		*!*						*** Matias L. 06/10/2023 #1682
		*!*						*lFormateado = .t.
		*!*						** Matias L. 01/11/2023 #1682						
		*!*	*!*					ENDFOR 
		
		*!*	*************************************** COMENTADO **************************
		*!*					*IF !lFormateado
		*!*					IF EMPTY(this.columns[nColumna].inputmask)
		*!*						nCampoArray = ASCAN(vEstructuraTabla, UPPER(ALLTRIM(SUBSTR(this.Columns[nColumna].controlSource, AT(".", this.Columns[nColumna].controlSource)+1))),-1,-1,1,8)
		*!*						IF nCampoArray <= ALEN(vEstructuraTabla,1) AND nCampoArray > 0
		*!*							nAnchoCampo	= vEstructuraTabla[nCampoArray,3]
		*!*							nDecimalesCampo = vEstructuraTabla[nCampoArray,4]
		*!*							this.columns[nColumna].inputmask = oApp.formatearInputMask(oApp.armarInputMask(nAnchoCampo, nDecimalesCampo, vEstructuraTabla[nCampoArray,2],this.columns[nColumna].parentClass))
		*!*						ENDIF 
		*!*					ENDIF
		
		*!*	*************************************** COMENTADO **************************
		
		*!*					*** Matias L. 06/10/2023 #1682
		*!*					lFormateado = .f.
		*!*					*** Matias L. 06/10/2023 #1682
		*!*				endfor
		*!*				*** Matias L. 19/05/2023 #1619
		
		*!*				
		*!*				
		*!*				
		*!*	*!*				FOR nColumna = 1 TO this.ColumnCount
		*!*	*!*					IF EMPTY(this.Columns[nColumna].inputMask)
		*!*	*!*						nCampoArray = ASCAN(vEstructuraTabla, UPPER(ALLTRIM(SUBSTR(this.Columns[nColumna].controlSource, AT(".", this.Columns[nColumna].controlSource)+1))))
		*!*	*!*						IF nCampoArray > 0
		*!*	*!*							IF nCampoArray % (ALEN(vEstructuraTabla,2)) = 0
		*!*	*!*								nCampoArray = INT(nCampoArray / (ALEN(vEstructuraTabla,2)))
		*!*	*!*							ELSE
		*!*	*!*								nCampoArray = INT(nCampoArray / (ALEN(vEstructuraTabla,2))) + 1
		*!*	*!*							ENDIF 
		*!*	*!*						
		*!*	*!*							IF nCampoArray <= ALEN(vEstructuraTabla,1) AND vEstructuraTabla[nCampoArray,2] = "N" 
		*!*	*!*								nAnchoCampo	= vEstructuraTabla[nCampoArray,3]
		*!*	*!*								nDecimalesCampo = vEstructuraTabla[nCampoArray,4]
		*!*	*!*								this.columns[nColumna].inputmask = oApp.formatearInputMask(oApp.armarInputMask(nAnchoCampo, nDecimalesCampo))
		*!*	*!*							ENDIF 
		*!*	*!*						ENDIF 
		*!*	*!*					ENDIF 
		*!*	*!*				ENDFOR 
		
		*!*			ENDIF 
		*!*		ENDIF 
		*!*	ENDIF 
		*!*	** Matías S. 08/06/16 **
		
		*!*	IF !EMPTY(cAliasAnt)
		*!*		SELECT (cAliasAnt)
		*!*	Endif	
		
		*!*	*!*	If !empty(this.RecordSource) 
		*!*	*!*		IF nRecno > 1 
		*!*	*!*			GO nRecno
		*!*	*!*		Endif
		*!*	*!*	ENDIF
		
		*!*	this.EspecificarFont
		
		
		**********************************************************************************************************************************
		*!*	If !empty(this.RecordSource)
		*!*		this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource)
		*!*	Endif	
		*!*	this.EspecificarFont
		*!*	If Type("ThisForm.EsConsultaGrid")="L" and Thisform.EsConsultaGrid
		*!*		If !Empty(This.oConfigGrilla.Campo)
		*!*			This.Ordenar()
		*!*		Endif
		*!*	Endif
		
		*!*	** VERSION NUEVA
		*!*	LOCAL cAliasAnt,nConta
		*!*	** Matías S. 08/06/16 **
		*!*	LOCAL vEstructuraTabla, nDecimalesCampo, nAnchoCampo, nCampoArray, nColumna, nObjetoColumna

		*!*	** Matías S. 08/06/16 **

		*!*	*** Matias L. 20/07/2023 #1619
		
		*!*	*** Matias L. 06/10/2023 #1682
		*!*	LOCAL oTblInputMaskIncompletas

		*!*				nconta = 1 + nconta
		*!*				SKIP IN (this.RecordSource)

		*!*		Endif

		*!*			GO TOP IN (this.RecordSource)
		*!*		Endif
		*!*		
		*!*	Endif
		
		
		*!*	** VERSION NUEVA
		
		*!*	** Matías S. 08/06/16 **

		*!*		&&GO TOP IN (this.RecordSource)
		*!*		
		*!*		IF !EOF(this.RecordSource)
		*!*			*** Matias L. 19/05/2023 #1619

		*!*	*!*				FOR nObjetoColumna = 1 TO this.columns[nColumna].controlCount
		*!*	*!*					IF TYPE("this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask") = "C" AND !EMPTY(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask)
		*!*	*!*						IF LEN(CHRTRAN(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask), "01234567989.", "")) = 0 && VAL(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask)) <> 0
		*!*	*!*							this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask = oApp.formatearInputMask(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask))
		*!*	*!*						ENDIF 
		*!*	*!*					ENDIF 
		*!*	*!*					
		*!*	*!*					IF !EMPTY(this.columns[nColumna].inputmask)
		*!*	*!*						IF LEN(CHRTRAN(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].inputmask), "01234567989.", "")) = 0 &&VAL(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].inputmask)) <> 0
		*!*	*!*							this.columns[nColumna].inputmask = oApp.formatearInputMask(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].inputmask))
		*!*	*!*						ENDIF 
		*!*	*!*					ENDIF 			
		*!*	*!*				ENDFOR 
		*!*	*!*			ENDFOR
		
		
		*!*			IF !EMPTY(this.RecordSource)

		*!*				FOR nColumna = 1 TO this.ColumnCount
		*!*					
		*!*					FOR nObjetoColumna = 1 TO this.columns[nColumna].controlCount
		*!*						IF TYPE("this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask") = "C" AND !EMPTY(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask)
		*!*							IF LEN(CHRTRAN(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask), "01234567989.", "")) = 0 && VAL(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask)) <> 0
		*!*								this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask = oApp.formatearInputMask(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask))
		*!*								lFormateado = .t.
		*!*							ENDIF 
		*!*						ENDIF

		*!*								this.columns[nColumna].inputmask = oApp.formatearInputMask(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].inputmask))
		*!*								lFormateado = .t.

		*!*						IF nCampoArray <= ALEN(vEstructuraTabla,1) AND nCampoArray > 0
		*!*							nAnchoCampo	= vEstructuraTabla[nCampoArray,3]
		*!*							nDecimalesCampo = vEstructuraTabla[nCampoArray,4]

		*!*						ENDIF 
		*!*					ENDIF

		*!*	*!*					IF EMPTY(this.Columns[nColumna].inputMask)
		*!*	*!*						nCampoArray = ASCAN(vEstructuraTabla, UPPER(ALLTRIM(SUBSTR(this.Columns[nColumna].controlSource, AT(".", this.Columns[nColumna].controlSource)+1))))
