		*!*	*!*		Endif
		*!*	*!*	Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE resaltarrenglon
		lParameters nColucero1,nColucero2,nColucero3,nColucero4,nColucero5,lLetraSiempreNegro
		** VERSION NUEVA
		Local mmpp,cAuxiliar
		
		*VFP 8 this.HighlightStyle= 2
		*VFP 8 this.Highlight=.t.
		
		** SACAR EN LA VERSION 8
		If Type("ThisForm.interlineado")="L" and !Thisform.interlineado
			this.setall("dynamicbackcolor","iif(this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource),rgb(0,0,0),rgb(255,255,255))","column")
			
			if !lLetraSiempreNegro
				this.setall("dynamicforecolor","iif(this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource),rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0))","column")
			else
				this.setall("dynamicforecolor","iif(this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource),rgb(0,0,0),rgb(0,0,0))","column")
			endif
		Endif
		
		this.ResaltaRenglon=.t.
		
		
		For mmpp= 1 to 5
			cAuxiliar="nColuCero"+Alltrim(Str(mmpp))
			If Type(cAuxiliar)=T_NUMERIC
				If &cAuxiliar<>0
					this.Columns(&cAuxiliar).DynamicForeColor="iif(Eval(this.Columns("+alltrim(Str(&cAuxiliar))+").ControlSource)=0,iif(this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource),rgb(0,0,0),rgb(255,255,255)),iif(this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource),rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0)))"	
				Endif	
			Endif	
		EndFor
		For mmpp=1 to this.ColumnCount
			If Type("this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1")<>"O"
				this.Columns(mmpp).AddObject("tg_TextGrid1","tg_textGrid")
			Endif	
			this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1.Visible=.t.
			this.Columns(mmpp).CurrentControl="tg_TextGrid1"
			this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1.BackColor=rgb(200,253,219) && rgb(168,177,202)
			this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1.ForeColor=rgb(0,0,0)
			this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1.SelectedBackColor=rgb(200,253,219)
			this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1.SelectedForeColor=rgb(0,0,0)
			If Type("this.Columns(mmpp).Text1")=T_OBJECT
				this.Columns(mmpp).Text1.MousePointer=1
			Endif	
		ENDFOR
		** VERSION NUEVA
		
		
		*!*	lParameters nColucero1,nColucero2,nColucero3,nColucero4,nColucero5
		*!*	Local mmpp,cAuxiliar
		
		*!*	this.setall("dynamicbackcolor","iif(this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource),rgb(0,0,0),rgb(255,255,255))","column")
		*!*	this.setall("dynamicforecolor","iif(this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource),rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0))","column")
		
		*!*	this.ResaltaRenglon=.t.
		
		*!*	For mmpp= 1 to 5
		*!*		cAuxiliar="nColuCero"+Alltrim(Str(mmpp))
		*!*		If Type(cAuxiliar)=T_NUMERIC
		*!*			If &cAuxiliar<>0
		*!*				this.Columns(&cAuxiliar).DynamicForeColor="iif(Eval(this.Columns("+alltrim(Str(&cAuxiliar))+").ControlSource)=0,iif(this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource),rgb(0,0,0),rgb(255,255,255)),iif(this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource),rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0)))"	
		*!*			Endif	
		*!*		Endif	
		*!*	EndFor
		*!*	For mmpp=1 to this.ColumnCount
		*!*		If Type("this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1")<>"O"
		*!*			this.Columns(mmpp).AddObject("tg_TextGrid1","tg_textGrid")
		*!*		Endif	
		*!*		this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1.Visible=.t.
		*!*		this.Columns(mmpp).CurrentControl="tg_TextGrid1"
		*!*		this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1.BackColor=rgb(0,0,0)
		*!*		this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1.ForeColor=rgb(255,255,255)
		*!*		this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1.SelectedBackColor=rgb(0,0,0)
		*!*		this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1.SelectedForeColor=rgb(255,255,255)
		*!*		If Type("this.Columns(mmpp).Text1")=T_OBJECT
		*!*			this.Columns(mmpp).Text1.MousePointer=1
		*!*		Endif	
		*!*	EndFor
		*!*	this.refresh
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE resizeheader
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE RightClick
		Lparameters cNombreColumna
		Local cAux,cCampo,cAliasAnt
		
		** VERSION NUEVA
		cAliasAnt=ALIAS()
		** VERSION NUEVA
		
		IF !EMPTY(cNombreColumna)
		
			cAux="This."+Alltrim(cNombreColumna)+".Controlsource"
			cCampo=&cAux
			If At(".",cCampo)>0
				cCampo=Substr(cCampo,At(".",cCampo)+1)
			EndIf
			This.oConfigGrilla.Campo=cCampo
			This.oConfigGrilla.Ascendente=!This.oConfigGrilla.Ascendente
			This.Refresh()
			
		Endif	
		
		
		** VERSION NUEVA
		IF !EMPTY(cAliasAnt)
			SELECT (cAliasAnt)
		Endif
		** VERSION NUEVA
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE rightclickceldaconsulta		&& rightclick
		* tg_grid :: RightClickCeldaConsulta
		LPARAMETERS cNombreColumna   && "COLUMN" + n
		LOCAL cAliasAnt, cAux, cCampo
		
		cAliasAnt = ALIAS()
		
		* Punto de quiebre para depurar / agregar lógica
		SET STEP ON
		
		IF VARTYPE(cNombreColumna) = 'C' AND !EMPTY(cNombreColumna)
		    cAux   = "THIS." + ALLTRIM(cNombreColumna) + ".ControlSource"
		    cCampo = &cAux
		    *--------------------------------------------------------
		    * Acá vas a poder usar cCampo (sin alias) o la columna:
		    * - THIS.oConfigGrilla.Campo = ...
		    * - Mostrar menú contextual, etc.
		    * Dejé sólo el esqueleto para no alterar nada.
		    *--------------------------------------------------------
		ENDIF
		
		IF !EMPTY(cAliasAnt)
		    SELECT (cAliasAnt)
		ENDIF
		RETURN
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE rightclickencelda
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE rightclickheaderconsulta
		** Matias L. 05/10/2023 #1682  SE COMENTO TODO LE METODO ABAJO Y SE REHIZO
		
		lParameters lSinMenu, cNombreColumna
		&& cNombreColumna ES "COLUMN" + n
		Local oMenu,vVector(1),vDatos(1),cAliasAnt, cAux, cInputMask, oFormConfigIputMask, cControlCount, cControlsource, cAux3, cAux2, cAux
		LOCAL cControlInputMask 
		** VERSION TASAS
		cAliasAnt=ALIAS()
		** VERSION TASAS
		
		oMenu=CreateObject("tg_MenuLib")
		
		vVector[1]="Grabar Configuración..."
		
		cAux2= "This."+Alltrim(cNombreColumna)+".Controlsource"
		cControlsource = &cAux2
		
		cAux3="This."+Alltrim(cNombreColumna)+".inputmask"
		
		cControlCount = "This."+Alltrim(cNombreColumna)+".controlCount"
		cAux= "This." + Alltrim(cNombreColumna) + ".objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask"
		cControlInputMask = cAux
		
			
						
		cInputMask = &cAux3
		IF oApp.oTblParametros.leer("separadorMiles")  AND TYPE(cControlsource) = "N"
			DIMENSION vVector[2]
			vVector[2]="Modificar cantidad de digitos."
		endif
		** Matias L. 05/10/2023 #1682
		
		If !lSinMenu
			oMenu.ShowMenu(@vVector)
			Do case 
				Case Bar()=1
					For mmpp=1 to This.ColumnCount
						Dimension vDatos(mmpp,3)
						vDatos(mmpp,1)=This.Columns(mmpp).Width
						vDatos(mmpp,2)=this.Columns(mmpp).ColumnOrder
						vDatos(mmpp,3)=this.Columns(mmpp).Name
					ENDFOR
		
					This.oConfigGrilla.GrabarConfiguracion(@vDatos)
					
				CASE Bar()=2
					oFormConfigIputMask = CreateObject("tg_configinputmask",OCCURS("9",SUBSTR(cInputMask,1,AT(".",cInputMask)-1)),OCCURS("9",SUBSTR(cInputMask,AT(".",cInputMask)+1)))
					oFormConfigIputMask.show()
					*&cAux = oFormConfigIputMask.nuevoinputmask 
					IF !oFormConfigIputMask.cancela
						FOR nObjetoColumna = 1 TO &cControlCount
							IF TYPE(cControlInputMask) = "C" AND !EMPTY(&cControlInputMask)
								IF LEN(CHRTRAN(ALLTRIM(&cControlInputMask), "01234567989.,", "")) = 0 && VAL(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask)) <> 0
									&cControlInputMask = oApp.formatearInputMask(oFormConfigIputMask.nuevoinputmask)
								ENDIF 
							ENDIF 		
						ENDFOR 
		
						IF !EMPTY(&cAux3)
							IF LEN(CHRTRAN(ALLTRIM(&cAux3), "01234567989.,", "")) = 0 &&VAL(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].inputmask)) <> 0
								&cAux3 = oApp.formatearInputMask(ALLTRIM(oFormConfigIputMask.nuevoinputmask))
							ENDIF 
						ENDIF 
										
						this.refresh
					endif
			EndCase	
		Else
			This.oConfigGrilla.GrabarConfiguracion(@vDatos)
		ENDIF
		
		** VERSION TASAS
		IF !EMPTY(cAliasAnt)
			SELECT (cAliasAnt)
		Endif
		** VERSION TASAS
		
		*!*	*lParameters lSinMenu
		*!*	Local oMenu,vVector(1),vDatos(1),cAliasAnt
		
		*!*	** VERSION TASAS
		*!*	cAliasAnt=ALIAS()
		*!*	** VERSION TASAS
		
		*!*	For mmpp=1 to This.ColumnCount
		*!*		Dimension vDatos(mmpp,3)
		*!*		vDatos(mmpp,1)=This.Columns(mmpp).Width
		*!*		vDatos(mmpp,2)=this.Columns(mmpp).ColumnOrder
		*!*		vDatos(mmpp,3)=this.Columns(mmpp).Name
		*!*	EndFor
		
		*!*	oMenu=CreateObject("tg_MenuLib")
		
		*!*	vVector[1]="Grabar Configuración..."
		
		*!*	If !lSinMenu
		*!*		oMenu.ShowMenu(@vVector)
		*!*		Do case 
		*!*			Case Bar()=1
		*!*				This.oConfigGrilla.GrabarConfiguracion(@vDatos)
		*!*		EndCase	
		*!*	Else
		*!*		This.oConfigGrilla.GrabarConfiguracion(@vDatos)
		*!*	Endif
		*!*	** VERSION TASAS
		*!*	IF !EMPTY(cAliasAnt)
		*!*		SELECT (cAliasAnt)
		*!*	Endif
		*!*	** VERSION TASAS
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="grid" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	#INCLUDE "..\include\target.h"

	PROCEDURE cargargrilla
		Lparameters vDatos
		Local mmpp,cAux
		For mmpp=1 to Alen(vDatos,1)
			cAux="this."+Alltrim(vDatos(mmpp,3))+".Width=vDatos(mmpp,1)"
			&cAux
			cAux="this."+Alltrim(vDatos(mmpp,3))+".ColumnOrder=vDatos(mmpp,2)"
			&cAux	
		EndFor
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE clickheader
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE dblclickencelda

		EndIf
		This.oConfigGrilla.Campo=cCampo
		This.oConfigGrilla.Ascendente=!This.oConfigGrilla.Ascendente
		This.Refresh()

		Endif

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE especificarfont
		** VERSION NUEVA
		Local mmpp
		For mmpp=1 to this.ColumnCount
			For mmmppp=1 to this.Columns(mmpp).ControlCount
				If Alltrim(Upper(this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).Class))=Upper("Header") or; && RODOLFO, RODOLFO 09-02-2007, SE AGREGA ESTO PARA QUE TOME BIEN EL FONT
					Alltrim(Upper(this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).Class))=Upper("Tg_Header")
					this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).FontBold=.f.
					this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).BackColor=Rgb(192,192,192)
		*			this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).BackColor=Rgb(227,239,251)
		*			this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).BackColor=Rgb(242,243,214)						
		*			this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).ForeColor=Rgb(255,255,255)
					this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).ForeColor=Rgb(0,0,0)			
				Endif	
			EndFor
		EndFor
		** VERSION NUEVA
		
		
		
		*!*	Local mmpp
		*!*	For mmpp=1 to this.ColumnCount
		*!*		For mmmppp=1 to this.Columns(mmpp).ControlCount
		*!*			If Alltrim(Upper(this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).Class))=Upper("Header") or; && RODOLFO, RODOLFO 09-02-2007, SE AGREGA ESTO PARA QUE TOME BIEN EL FONT
		*!*				Alltrim(Upper(this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).Class))=Upper("Tg_Header")
		*!*				this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).FontBold=.f.
		*!*				this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).BackColor=Rgb(128,128,128)
		*!*				this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).ForeColor=Rgb(255,255,255)			
		*!*			Endif	
		*!*		EndFor
		*!*	EndFor
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		Local mmpp,vDatos(1)
		Local lAlignment,nBackColor ,cCaption,cFontBold ,cFontCharSet,lFontCondense,lFontExtend
		Local lFontItalic,cFontName,cFontOutline ,cFontShadow,nFontSize,lFontStrikeThru ,lFontUnderline,nForeColor
		Local cPicture,cStatusBarText,cToolTipText,lWordWrap     
		
		** VERSION NUEVA
		LOCAL oGrid
		cAliasAnt=ALIAS()  
		** VERSION NUEVA
		
		If Type("ThisForm.EsConsultaGrid")="L" and Thisform.EsConsultaGrid
			For mmpp=1 to this.ColumnCount
				
				
				
				
				Dimension this.vAnchoColumnas[mmpp]
				this.vAnchoColumnas[mmpp]=this.Columns(mmpp).Width
				
				lAlignment=this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.Alignment
				nBackColor =this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.BackColor 
				cCaption=this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.Caption
				cFontBold =this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontBold 
				lFontCondense=this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontCondense
				lFontExtend =this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontExtend 
				lFontItalic=this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontItalic
				cFontName=this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontName
				cFontOutline =this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontOutline 
				cFontShadow=this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontShadow
				nFontSize=this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontSize
				lFontStrikeThru =this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontStrikeThru 
				lFontUnderline=this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontUnderline
				nForeColor=this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.ForeColor
				This.Columns(mmpp).AddObject("Header2","tg_Header")
				This.Columns(mmpp).Header2.Name="Header1"
				this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.Alignment=lAlignment
				this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.BackColor =nBackColor 
				this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.Caption=cCaption
				this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontBold =cFontBold 
				this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontCondense=lFontCondense
				this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontExtend =lFontExtend
				this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontItalic=lFontItalic
				this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontName=cFontName
				this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontOutline=cFontOutline 
				this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontShadow=cFontShadow
				this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontSize=nFontSize
				this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontStrikeThru=lFontStrikeThru  
				This.Columns(mmpp).Header1.FontUnderline=lFontUnderline
				this.Columns(mmpp).Header1.ForeColor=nForeColor
		
			** VERSION NUEVA
			EndFor
			This.oConfigGrilla=CreateObject("tg_ConfigGrid",oApp.Usuario,Thisform.Class,@vDatos)
			
			If Type("vDatos")<>"L"
			
			
			    ** Gustavo 22/06/22 si el resize esta desactivado cargo la grilla aca de lo contrario en tg_form despues de agrandar o achicar el formulario
			   
				*IF !oApp.oTblParametros.ExisteCampo("ResizerDesActivado") or  oApp.oTblParametros.Leer("ResizerDesActivado")	   
			    	This.CargarGrilla(@vDatos)
				   
				*endif   
				** Gustavo 22/06/22
			
			ENDIF
		Else
			For mmpp=1 to this.ColumnCount
				Dimension this.vAnchoColumnas[mmpp]
				this.vAnchoColumnas[mmpp]=this.Columns(mmpp).Width
			EndFor
		ENDIF
			
		If Type("ThisForm.interlineado")="L" and Thisform.interlineado
				this.setall("dynamicbackcolor","iif(Mod(interlineadogrilla,2)=0 and interlineadogrilla<>0,rgb(252,252,252),rgb(239,242,250))","column")
		ENDIF
					
		this.Recno=1
		this.EspecificarFont
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE KeyPress
		LPARAMETERS nKeyCode, nShiftAltCtrl
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ordenar
		Local cCampoOrden,oTabla,lSalir,mmpp,oControl,vcontrolSourceColumnas(This.ColumnCount),cAliasAnt
		lSalir=.F.
		mmpp=1
		
		** VERSION NUEVA
		cAliasAnt=ALIAS()    
		** VERSION NUEVA
		
		if !empty(this.RecordSource)
			DO While !lSalir and mmpp<=Thisform.ControlCount
				oControl=Thisform.Controls(mmpp)
				If (Upper(oControl.Class)="TG_TABLA" or Upper(oControl.ParentClass)="TG_VIEW") and Upper(oControl.Alias)=Upper(This.RecordSource)
					oTabla=oControl
					lSalir=.T.
					Release oControl
				EndIf
				mmpp=mmpp+1
			EndDo
			If !oTabla.EsTablaVacia()
				For mmpp=1 to This.ColumnCount
					vcontrolSourceColumnas[mmpp]=This.Columns(mmpp).ControlSource
				EndFor
				This.RecordSource=""
				This.oConfigGrilla.OrdenarGrilla(oTabla)
				oTabla.IrPrimero()
				This.RecordSource=oTabla.Alias
				For mmpp=1 to This.ColumnCount
					This.Columns(mmpp).ControlSource=vcontrolSourceColumnas[mmpp]
				EndFor
			Endif
		endif	
		
		** VERSION NUEVA
		IF !EMPTY(cAliasAnt)
			SELECT (cAliasAnt)
		Endif
		** VERSION NUEVA
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarrenglon
		this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Refresh
		** VERSION NUEVA
		LOCAL cAliasAnt,nConta
		** Matías S. 08/06/16 **
		LOCAL vEstructuraTabla, nDecimalesCampo, nAnchoCampo, nCampoArray, nColumna, nObjetoColumna
		DIMENSION vEstructuraTabla[1,2]
		** Matías S. 08/06/16 **
		
		*** Matias L. 20/07/2023 #1619
		LOCAL lFormateado
		*** Matias L. 20/07/2023 #1619
		
		LOCAL nRecno
		
		cAliasAnt=ALIAS()
		
		*!*	nRecno = 0
		
		*!*	If !empty(this.RecordSource) 
		*!*		nRecno = recno(this.RecordSource)
		*!*	ENDIF
		
		
		If !empty(this.RecordSource) 
			this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource)
		
			If Type("ThisForm.EsConsultaGrid")="L" and Thisform.EsConsultaGrid
				If !Empty(This.oConfigGrilla.Campo)
					This.Ordenar()
				Endif
			ENDIF
		
			nconta=1
			cAliasant = SELECT()
		
			SELECT (this.RecordSource)
		
			IF TYPE("interlineadogrilla") = "N"
				DO WHILE NOT EOF(this.RecordSource)
					Replace interlineadogrilla WITH nconta IN (this.RecordSource)
					nconta = 1 + nconta
					SKIP IN (this.RecordSource)
				ENDDO
			Endif	
				
			If Type("ThisForm.EsConsultaGrid")="L" and Thisform.EsConsultaGrid		
				GO TOP IN (this.RecordSource)
			Endif
			
		Endif
		
		
		** VERSION NUEVA
		
		** Matías S. 08/06/16 **
		IF oApp.oTblParametros.leer("separadorMiles") AND !EMPTY(this.RecordSource)
		
			cAliasAnt = SELECT()
			SELECT(this.RecordSource)
			&&GO TOP IN (this.RecordSource)
			
			IF !EOF(this.RecordSource)
				*** Matias L. 19/05/2023 #1619
		
		*!*			FOR nColumna = 1 TO this.columnCount
		*!*				FOR nObjetoColumna = 1 TO this.columns[nColumna].controlCount
		*!*					IF TYPE("this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask") = "C" AND !EMPTY(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask)
		*!*						IF LEN(CHRTRAN(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask), "01234567989.", "")) = 0 && VAL(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask)) <> 0
		*!*							this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask = oApp.formatearInputMask(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask))
		*!*						ENDIF 
		*!*					ENDIF 
		*!*					
		*!*					IF !EMPTY(this.columns[nColumna].inputmask)
		*!*						IF LEN(CHRTRAN(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].inputmask), "01234567989.", "")) = 0 &&VAL(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].inputmask)) <> 0
		*!*							this.columns[nColumna].inputmask = oApp.formatearInputMask(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].inputmask))
		*!*						ENDIF 
		*!*					ENDIF 			
		*!*				ENDFOR 
		*!*			ENDFOR
		
		
				IF !EMPTY(this.RecordSource)
					AFIELDS(vEstructuraTabla, this.RecordSource)
					
					*** Matias L. 19/05/2023 #1619
					FOR nColumna = 1 TO this.ColumnCount
						
						FOR nObjetoColumna = 1 TO this.columns[nColumna].controlCount
							IF TYPE("this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask") = "C" AND !EMPTY(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask)
								IF LEN(CHRTRAN(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask), "01234567989.", "")) = 0 && VAL(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask)) <> 0
									this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask = oApp.formatearInputMask(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].objects[nObjetoColumna].inputmask))
									lFormateado = .t.
								ENDIF 
							ENDIF 
							
							IF !EMPTY(this.columns[nColumna].inputmask)
								IF LEN(CHRTRAN(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].inputmask), "01234567989.", "")) = 0 &&VAL(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].inputmask)) <> 0
									this.columns[nColumna].inputmask = oApp.formatearInputMask(ALLTRIM(this.columns[nColumna].inputmask))
									lFormateado = .t.
								ENDIF 
							ENDIF 			
						ENDFOR 
		
						IF !lFormateado
							nCampoArray = ASCAN(vEstructuraTabla, UPPER(ALLTRIM(SUBSTR(this.Columns[nColumna].controlSource, AT(".", this.Columns[nColumna].controlSource)+1))),-1,-1,1,8)
							IF nCampoArray <= ALEN(vEstructuraTabla,1) AND nCampoArray > 0
								nAnchoCampo	= vEstructuraTabla[nCampoArray,3]
								nDecimalesCampo = vEstructuraTabla[nCampoArray,4]
								this.columns[nColumna].inputmask = oApp.formatearInputMask(oApp.armarInputMask(nAnchoCampo, nDecimalesCampo, vEstructuraTabla[nCampoArray,2],this.columns[nColumna].parentClass))
							ENDIF 
						ENDIF
					endfor
					*** Matias L. 19/05/2023 #1619
		
					
					
					
		*!*				FOR nColumna = 1 TO this.ColumnCount
		*!*					IF EMPTY(this.Columns[nColumna].inputMask)
		*!*						nCampoArray = ASCAN(vEstructuraTabla, UPPER(ALLTRIM(SUBSTR(this.Columns[nColumna].controlSource, AT(".", this.Columns[nColumna].controlSource)+1))))
		*!*						IF nCampoArray > 0
		*!*							IF nCampoArray % (ALEN(vEstructuraTabla,2)) = 0
		*!*								nCampoArray = INT(nCampoArray / (ALEN(vEstructuraTabla,2)))
		*!*							ELSE
		*!*								nCampoArray = INT(nCampoArray / (ALEN(vEstructuraTabla,2))) + 1
		*!*							ENDIF 
		*!*						
		*!*							IF nCampoArray <= ALEN(vEstructuraTabla,1) AND vEstructuraTabla[nCampoArray,2] = "N" 
		*!*								nAnchoCampo	= vEstructuraTabla[nCampoArray,3]
		*!*								nDecimalesCampo = vEstructuraTabla[nCampoArray,4]
		*!*								this.columns[nColumna].inputmask = oApp.formatearInputMask(oApp.armarInputMask(nAnchoCampo, nDecimalesCampo))
		*!*							ENDIF 
		*!*						ENDIF 
		*!*					ENDIF 
		*!*				ENDFOR 
		
				ENDIF 
			ENDIF 
		ENDIF 
		** Matías S. 08/06/16 **
		
		IF !EMPTY(cAliasAnt)
			SELECT (cAliasAnt)
		Endif	
		
		*!*	If !empty(this.RecordSource) 
		*!*		IF nRecno > 1 
		*!*			GO nRecno
		*!*		Endif
		*!*	ENDIF
		
		this.EspecificarFont
		
		
		*!*	If !empty(this.RecordSource)
		*!*		this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource)
		*!*	Endif	
		*!*	this.EspecificarFont
		*!*	If Type("ThisForm.EsConsultaGrid")="L" and Thisform.EsConsultaGrid
		*!*		If !Empty(This.oConfigGrilla.Campo)
		*!*			This.Ordenar()
		*!*		Endif
		*!*	Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE resaltarrenglon
		lParameters nColucero1,nColucero2,nColucero3,nColucero4,nColucero5,lLetraSiempreNegro
		** VERSION NUEVA
		Local mmpp,cAuxiliar
		
		*VFP 8 this.HighlightStyle= 2
		*VFP 8 this.Highlight=.t.
		
		** SACAR EN LA VERSION 8
		If Type("ThisForm.interlineado")="L" and !Thisform.interlineado
			this.setall("dynamicbackcolor","iif(this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource),rgb(0,0,0),rgb(255,255,255))","column")
			
			if !lLetraSiempreNegro
				this.setall("dynamicforecolor","iif(this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource),rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0))","column")
			else
				this.setall("dynamicforecolor","iif(this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource),rgb(0,0,0),rgb(0,0,0))","column")
			endif
		Endif
		
		this.ResaltaRenglon=.t.
		
		
		For mmpp= 1 to 5
			cAuxiliar="nColuCero"+Alltrim(Str(mmpp))
			If Type(cAuxiliar)=T_NUMERIC
				If &cAuxiliar<>0
					this.Columns(&cAuxiliar).DynamicForeColor="iif(Eval(this.Columns("+alltrim(Str(&cAuxiliar))+").ControlSource)=0,iif(this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource),rgb(0,0,0),rgb(255,255,255)),iif(this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource),rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0)))"	
				Endif	
			Endif	
		EndFor
		For mmpp=1 to this.ColumnCount
			If Type("this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1")<>"O"
				this.Columns(mmpp).AddObject("tg_TextGrid1","tg_textGrid")
			Endif	
			this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1.Visible=.t.
			this.Columns(mmpp).CurrentControl="tg_TextGrid1"
			this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1.BackColor=rgb(200,253,219) && rgb(168,177,202)
			this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1.ForeColor=rgb(0,0,0)
			this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1.SelectedBackColor=rgb(200,253,219)
			this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1.SelectedForeColor=rgb(0,0,0)
			If Type("this.Columns(mmpp).Text1")=T_OBJECT
				this.Columns(mmpp).Text1.MousePointer=1
			Endif	
		ENDFOR
		** VERSION NUEVA
		
		
		*!*	lParameters nColucero1,nColucero2,nColucero3,nColucero4,nColucero5
		*!*	Local mmpp,cAuxiliar
		
		*!*	this.setall("dynamicbackcolor","iif(this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource),rgb(0,0,0),rgb(255,255,255))","column")
		*!*	this.setall("dynamicforecolor","iif(this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource),rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0))","column")
		
		*!*	this.ResaltaRenglon=.t.
		
		*!*	For mmpp= 1 to 5
		*!*		cAuxiliar="nColuCero"+Alltrim(Str(mmpp))
		*!*		If Type(cAuxiliar)=T_NUMERIC
		*!*			If &cAuxiliar<>0
		*!*				this.Columns(&cAuxiliar).DynamicForeColor="iif(Eval(this.Columns("+alltrim(Str(&cAuxiliar))+").ControlSource)=0,iif(this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource),rgb(0,0,0),rgb(255,255,255)),iif(this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource),rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0)))"	
		*!*			Endif	
		*!*		Endif	
		*!*	EndFor
		*!*	For mmpp=1 to this.ColumnCount
		*!*		If Type("this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1")<>"O"
		*!*			this.Columns(mmpp).AddObject("tg_TextGrid1","tg_textGrid")
		*!*		Endif	
		*!*		this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1.Visible=.t.
		*!*		this.Columns(mmpp).CurrentControl="tg_TextGrid1"
		*!*		this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1.BackColor=rgb(0,0,0)
		*!*		this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1.ForeColor=rgb(255,255,255)
		*!*		this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1.SelectedBackColor=rgb(0,0,0)
		*!*		this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1.SelectedForeColor=rgb(255,255,255)
		*!*		If Type("this.Columns(mmpp).Text1")=T_OBJECT
		*!*			this.Columns(mmpp).Text1.MousePointer=1
		*!*		Endif	
		*!*	EndFor
		*!*	this.refresh
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE resizeheader
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE rightclickencelda
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE rightclickheaderconsulta
		lParameters lSinMenu
		
		Local oMenu,vVector(1),vDatos(1),cAliasAnt
		
		** VERSION TASAS
		cAliasAnt=ALIAS()
		** VERSION TASAS
		
		For mmpp=1 to This.ColumnCount
			Dimension vDatos(mmpp,3)
			vDatos(mmpp,1)=This.Columns(mmpp).Width
			vDatos(mmpp,2)=this.Columns(mmpp).ColumnOrder
			vDatos(mmpp,3)=this.Columns(mmpp).Name
		EndFor
		
		oMenu=CreateObject("tg_MenuLib")
		
		vVector[1]="Grabar Configuración..."
		If !lSinMenu
			oMenu.ShowMenu(@vVector)
			Do case 
				Case Bar()=1
					This.oConfigGrilla.GrabarConfiguracion(@vDatos)
			EndCase	
		Else
			This.oConfigGrilla.GrabarConfiguracion(@vDatos)
		Endif
		** VERSION TASAS
		IF !EMPTY(cAliasAnt)
			SELECT (cAliasAnt)
		Endif
		** VERSION TASAS
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

DEFINE CLASS tg_gridold AS grid 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="grid" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	#INCLUDE "..\include\target.h"
	*<DefinedPropArrayMethod>
		*m: clickheader
		*m: dblclickencelda
		*m: dblclickheader
		*m: especificarfont
		*m: refrescarrenglon
		*m: resaltarrenglon
		*m: resizeheader
		*m: rightclickencelda
		*p: recno
		*p: registro
		*p: resaltarenglon
		*a: vanchocolumnas[1,0]
	*</DefinedPropArrayMethod>

	*<PropValue>
		DeleteMark = .F.
		FontBold = .F.
		FontName = "MS Sans Serif"
		FontSize = 8
		Highlight = .F.
		Name = "tg_gridold"
		RowHeight = 16
		Width = 320
	*</PropValue>
	
	PROCEDURE clickheader
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE dblclickencelda
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE dblclickheader
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE especificarfont
		Local mmpp
		For mmpp=1 to this.ColumnCount
			For mmmppp=1 to this.Columns(mmpp).ControlCount
				If Alltrim(Upper(this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).Class))=Upper("Header")
					this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).FontBold=.f.
					this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).BackColor=Rgb(128,128,128)
					this.Columns(mmpp).Controls(mmmppp).ForeColor=Rgb(255,255,255)			
				Endif	
			EndFor
		EndFor
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		Local mmpp
		For mmpp=1 to this.ColumnCount
			Dimension this.vAnchoColumnas[mmpp]
			this.vAnchoColumnas[mmpp]=this.Columns(mmpp).Width
		EndFor
		this.Recno=1
		this.EspecificarFont
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarrenglon
		this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Refresh
		If !empty(this.RecordSource)
			this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource)
		Endif	
		this.EspecificarFont
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE resaltarrenglon
		lParameters nColucero1,nColucero2,nColucero3,nColucero4,nColucero5
		Local mmpp,cAuxiliar
		
		this.setall("dynamicbackcolor","iif(this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource),rgb(0,0,0),rgb(255,255,255))","column")
		this.setall("dynamicforecolor","iif(this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource),rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0))","column")
		
		this.ResaltaRenglon=.t.
		
		For mmpp= 1 to 5
			cAuxiliar="nColuCero"+Alltrim(Str(mmpp))
			If Type(cAuxiliar)=T_NUMERIC
				If &cAuxiliar<>0
					this.Columns(&cAuxiliar).DynamicForeColor="iif(Eval(this.Columns("+alltrim(Str(&cAuxiliar))+").ControlSource)=0,iif(this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource),rgb(0,0,0),rgb(255,255,255)),iif(this.recno=recno(this.RecordSource),rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0)))"	
				Endif	
			Endif	
		EndFor
		For mmpp=1 to this.ColumnCount
			If Type("this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1")<>"O"
				this.Columns(mmpp).AddObject("tg_TextGrid1","tg_textGrid")
			Endif	
			this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1.Visible=.t.
			this.Columns(mmpp).CurrentControl="tg_TextGrid1"
			this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1.BackColor=rgb(0,0,0)
			this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1.ForeColor=rgb(255,255,255)
			this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1.SelectedBackColor=rgb(0,0,0)
			this.Columns(mmpp).tg_TextGrid1.SelectedForeColor=rgb(255,255,255)
			If Type("this.Columns(mmpp).Text1")=T_OBJECT
				this.Columns(mmpp).Text1.MousePointer=1
			Endif	
		EndFor
		this.refresh
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE resizeheader
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE rightclickencelda
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

DEFINE CLASS tg_textbox AS textbox 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="textbox" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	#INCLUDE "..\include\target.h"
	*<DefinedPropArrayMethod>
		*m: asignarobjeto
		*m: crearyasignarobjeto
		*m: registrarobjeto
		*m: seleccionartexto
		*p: intchangeexpresion
		*p: intchangeexpresion2
		*p: prgchangeexpresion
		*p: prgchangeexpresion2
		*p: validexpresion
		*p: whenexpresion
		*a: vobjetos[1,0]
	*</DefinedPropArrayMethod>

	*<PropValue>
		Alignment = 3
		DisabledForeColor = 0,0,0
		FontBold = .F.
		FontName = "Segoe UI"
		FontSize = 8
		ForeColor = 60,60,60
		Height = 21
		Name = "tg_textbox"
		validexpresion = 
		whenexpresion = 
		Width = 113
	*</PropValue>
	
	PROCEDURE asignarobjeto
		lParameters cDestino,cObjeto
		this.RegistrarObjeto(cDestino)
		&cDestino=cObjeto
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE crearyasignarobjeto
		lParameters cDestino,cClase,nPar1,nPar2,nPar3,nPar4,nPar5,nPar6,nPar7,nPar8,nPar9,nPar10,nPar11,nPar12,nPar13,nPar14,nPar15
		Local mmpp,cParametros,cOperacion
		cParametros=""
		
		For mmpp=1 to parameters()-2
			cParametros=cParametros+",nPar"+Alltrim(str(mmpp))
		EndFor
		If cParametros<>""
			cParametros=substr(cParametros,2)
		Endif	
		cOperacion=cDestino+"=CreateObject('"+Alltrim(cCLase)+"'"+iif(parameters()-2>0,",","")+alltrim(cParametros)+")"
		
		this.RegistrarObjeto(cDestino)
		&cOperacion
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Destroy
		Local mmpp
		for mmpp=1 to alen(this.vobjetos)
			mvaraux=this.vobjetos[mmpp]
			if type("mVarAux")<>T_LOGICAL
				&mVarAux=3 &&..Destroy
			endif	
		endfor
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		DODEFAULT()
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE KeyPress
		LPARAMETERS nKeyCode, nShiftAltCtrl
		
		IF nKeyCode = 46
			IF AT("99", this.InputMask) > 0
				keyboard(",")
			ENDIF
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE registrarobjeto
		lparameters mobjeto
		local multimo
		multimo=1
		if type("this.vobjetos[1]")=T_CHARACTER
			multimo=alen(this.vobjetos)+1
			dimension this.vobjetos[multimo]
		endif
		this.vobjetos[multimo]=mobjeto
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seleccionartexto
		this.SelStart=0
		Do Case
			Case Type("this.Value")=T_DATE
				this.SelLength=8
			Case Type("this.Value")=T_NUMERIC
				this.SelLength=Len(Str(this.Value))
			Case Type("this.Value")=T_CHARACTER
				this.SelLength=Len(Alltrim(this.Value))
		EndCase
				
				
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Valid
		if alltrim(this.validExpresion)<>""
			return eval(alltrim(this.validExpresion))
		else
		    return .t.
		endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE When
		if alltrim(this.WhenExpresion)<>""
			return eval(alltrim(this.WhenExpresion))
		else
		    return .t.
		endif
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="timer" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

DEFINE CLASS tg_toolbar AS toolbar 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="toolbar" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	#INCLUDE "..\include\target.h"
	*<DefinedPropArrayMethod>
		*m: restorewindowpos
		*m: savewindowpos
		*m: setear
	*</DefinedPropArrayMethod>

	*<PropValue>
		Caption = "Toolbar1"
		ControlBox = .F.
		Height = 22
		Left = 0
		Name = "tg_toolbar"
		Top = 0
		Width = 33
	*</PropValue>
	
	PROCEDURE Destroy
		*-- Guardar la posición de la barra de herramientas
		this.SaveWindowPos()
		this.visible=.f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		*-- Restaurar la posición de la barra de herramientas
		IF !this.RestoreWindowPos()
		  *-- El valor predeterminado es anclar la barra de herramientas en la parte superior
		  this.Dock(TOOL_TOP)
		ENDIF
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE restorewindowpos
		LOCAL  lcBuffer, ;
		      lcOldError, ;
		      lnTop, ;
		      lnLeft, ;
		      llError, ;
		      lnCommaPos, ;
		      lnDockPosition
		      
			
		lcBuffer = SPACE(10) + CHR(0)
		lcOldError = ON('ERROR')
		lnDockPosition = 0
		*-- Escribir la posición de la barra de herramientas en el archivo INI
		*!*	IF GetPrivStr("WindowPositions", this.Caption, "", ;
		*!*	               @lcBuffer, LEN(lcBuffer), ;
		*!*	               CURDIR() + TG_INIFILE) > 0
		
		IF GetPrivStr("WindowPositions", this.Caption, "", ;
		               @lcBuffer, LEN(lcBuffer), ;
		               oApp.ArchivoIni()) > 0
		
		   	               
		  *-- Si ocurre un error al analizar la cadena,
		  *-- pasar por alto la cadena y utilizar los valores
		  *-- predeterminados del formulario
		  ON ERROR llError = .T.
		  lnCommaPos = AT(",", lcBuffer)
		  IF lnCommaPos > 0
		    lnTop  = VAL(LEFT(lcBuffer, lnCommaPos - 1))
		    lnLeft = VAL(SUBSTR(lcBuffer, lnCommaPos + 1))
		  ELSE
		    lnDockPosition = VAL(lcBuffer)
		  ENDIF
		  ON ERROR &lcOldError
		  IF !llError
		    *-- Si la posición contiene una coma, establecer
		    *-- las propiedades apropriadas; de lo contrario, llamar
		    *-- al método Dock.
		    IF lnCommaPos > 0
		      this.Top = lnTop
		      this.Left = lnLeft
		    ELSE
		      this.Dock(lnDockPosition)
		    ENDIF
		  ENDIF
		ELSE
		  RETURN .F.
		ENDIF
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE savewindowpos
		LOCAL lcValue
		
		if type("oApp")=T_OBJECT
			IF this.Docked
			  lcValue = ALLT(STR(this.DockPosition))
			ELSE
			  lcValue = ALLT(STR(thisform.Top)) + ',' + ;
			            ALLT(STR(thisform.Left))
			ENDIF
		*!*	=WritePrivStr("WindowPositions", this.Caption, ;
		*!*	              lcValue, CURDIR() + TG_INIFILE)
			=WritePrivStr("WindowPositions", this.Caption, ;
			              lcValue,oApp.ArchivoIni())
		Endif	              
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setear
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

DEFINE CLASS tg_toolboton AS tg_commandbutton OF "tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="commandbutton" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	#INCLUDE "..\include\target.h"
	*<PropValue>
		Height = 22
		Name = "tg_toolboton"
		Width = 22
	*</PropValue>

ENDDEFINE
